dvaitaprapañcasyāvidyākṛtatvād vidyayā tad upaśamaḥ syād iti brahmavidyāprakāśanāyāsya ārambhaḥ kriyate
tatra tāvad oṃkāranirṇayāya prathamaṃ prakaraṇam āgamapradhānām ātmatattvapratipatty upāyabhūtam
kathaṃ puna oṃkāranirṇaya ātmatattvapratipatty upāyatvaṃ pratipadyata ity ucyate"oṃ ity etat" "etad ālambanam" "etad vai satyakāma" "oṃ ity ātmānaṃ yuñjīta" "oṃ iti brahma" "oṃkāra evedaṃ sarvam" (chā.u.2 / 23 / 3) ity ādi śrutibhyaḥ
rajjur ādir iva sarpādivikalpasyāspado 'dvaya ātmā paramārthaḥ sanprāṇādivikalpasyāspado yathā tathā sarvo 'pi vākprapañcaḥ prāṇādy ātmavikalpaviṣaya oṃkāra eva
oṃkāravikāraśabdābhidheyaś ca sarvaḥ prāṇādir ātmavikalpo 'bhidhānavyatirekeṇa nāsti
oṃ ity etad akṣaram idaṃ sarvaṃ tasyopavyākhyānaṃ bhūtaṃ bhavad bhaviṣyad iti sarvam oṃkāra eva
yac cānyat trikālātītaṃ tad apy oṃkāra eva
yad idam arthajātam abhidheyabhūtaṃ tasyābhidhānāvyatirekād abhidhānasya ca oṃkārāvyatirekād oṃkāra evedaṃ sarvam
paraṃ ca brahmābhidhānābhidheya upāyapūrvakam eva gamyata ity oṃkāra eva
bhūtaṃ bhavadbhaviṣyad iti kālatrayaparicchedyaṃ yat tad apy oṃkāra evoktanyāyataḥ
yac cānyat trikālātītaṃ kāryādhigamyaṃ kālāparicchedyamavyākṛtādi tad apy oṃkāra eva
sarvaṃ yad uktam oṃkāramātram iti tadetad brahma
so 'yamātma oṃkārābhidheyaḥ parāparatvena vyavasthitaś catuṣpātkārṣāpaṇavan na gaur iveti
bahiṣprajñaḥ svātmavyatirikte viṣaye prajñā sa bahiṣprajño bahir viṣaya eva prajñāvidyākṛtāv avabhāsata ity arthaḥ
satāṃ vidyamānānāṃ svenāvidyākṛtanāmarūpamāyāsvarūpeṇa sarvabhāvānāṃ viśvataijasaprājñabhedānāṃ prabhavotpattiḥ
abhidheyapradhāna oṃkāraś catuṣpādātmeti vyākhyāto yaḥ
so 'yam ātmādhyakṣaram oṃkāraḥ
kiṃ punas tadakṣaram ity āha oṃkāraḥ
so 'yam oṃkāraḥ pādaśaḥ pravibhajyamāno 'dhimātraṃ mātrām adhikṛtya vartata ity adhimātram
katham? ātmano ye pādāsta oṃkārasya mātrāḥ
jāgaritasthāno vaiśvānaro yaḥ sa oṃkārasyākāraḥ prathamā mātrā
svapnasthānas taijaso yaḥ sa oṃkārasyokāro dvitīyā mātrā
suṣuptasthānaḥ prājño yaḥ sa oṃkārasya makāras tṛtīyā mātrā
oṃkāra uccāraṇe hy antyākṣara ekībhūtāvivākāra oṃkārau
yathoktaiḥ sāmānyair ātmapādānāṃ mātrābhiḥ sahaikatvaṃ kṛtvā yathoktam oṃkāraṃ pratipadya yo dhyāyati tam
akārālambanam oṃkāraṃ vidvān vaiśvānaro bhavatīty arthaḥ
kṣīṇe tu makāre bījabhāvakṣayādamātra oṃkāre gatir na vidyate kvacid ity arthaḥ
evam oṃkāra ātmaiva
amātro mātrā yasya nāsti sa amātra oṃkāraś caturthas turīya ātmaiva kevalo 'bhidhānābhidheyarūpayor avāṅmanasayoḥ kṣīṇatvād avyavahāryaḥ
prapañca upaśamaḥ śivo 'dvaitaḥ saṃvṛtta evaṃ yathokta vijñānavatā prayukta oṃkāras trimātras tripāda ātmaiva
mandamadhyamadhiyāṃ tu pratipannasādhakabhāvānāṃ sanmārgagāmināṃ saṃnyāsināṃ mātrāṇāṃ pādānāṃ ca kḷptasāmānyavidāṃ yathāvad upāsyamāna oṃkāro brahmapratipattaya ālambanī bhavati tathā ca vakṣyati'āśramās trividhāḥ'(mā.kā.3.16) ityādi
oṃkāraṃ pādaśo vidyāt pādā mātrā na saṃśayaḥ
oṃkāraṃ pādaśo jñātvā na kiñcid api cintayet
yathoktaiḥ sāmānyaiḥ pādaiva mātrā mātrāś ca pādās tasmād oṃṅkāraṃ pādaśo vidyād ityarthaḥ
evam oṃkāre jñāte dṛṣṭārtham adṛṣṭārthaṃ vā na kiñcit prayojanaṃ cintayet kṛtārthatvād ityarthaḥ
praṇavaṃ hīśvaraṃ vidyāt sarvasya hṛdi saṃsthitam
sarvavyāpinam oṃkāraṃ matvā dhīro na śocati
sarvaprāṇijātasya smṛtipratyayāspade hṛdaye sthitam īśvaraṃ praṇavaṃ vidyāt sarvavyāpinaṃ vyomavad oṃkāram ātmānam asaṃsāriṇaṃ dhīro buddhimān matvā na śocati
oṃkāro vidito yena sa munir netāro janaḥ
amātras turīya oṃkāraḥ
oṃkaro yathā vyākhyāto vidito yena sa paramārthatatvasya mananān muniḥ

brūhi kena prakāreṇa tamahaṃ sa ma ātmeti vidyām
yāvadayamevaṃ yathoktamimamātmānaṃ na vetti tāvadayaṃ bāhyānityadṛṣṭilakṣaṇamupādhimātmatvenopetya avidyayā upādhidharmānātmano manyamāno brahmādistambaparyanteṣu devatiryaṅnarasthāneṣu punaḥ punarāvartamāno 'vidyākāmakarmavaśātsaṃsarati

oṃ namo brahmādibhyo brahmavidyāsampradāyakartṛbhyo vaṃśaṛṣibhyo namo gurubhyaḥ
"svayañjyotiḥ" (bṛ.u. 4 / 3 / 9) ityupakramya"taṃ vidyākarmaṇi samanvāramete" "puṇyo vai puṇena karmaṇā bhavati pāpaḥ pāpena" iti ca
evaṃ brahmāndyā sthāvarāntā svābhāvikāvidyādidoṣavatī dharmādharmasādhanakṛtā saṃsāragatirnāmarūpakarmāśrayā
sa eṣa bījāṅkurādivadavidyākṛtaḥ saṃsāra ātmani kriyākārakaphalādhyāropalakṣaṇo 'nādirananto 'narthaḥ, ityetasmādviraktasyāvidyānivṛttaye tadviparītabrahmavidyāpratipattyarthopaniṣadārabhyate
vidyāprakaraṇe cāmnānāt karmāntare ca sampādanadarśanād vijñānāt tatphalaprāptirastītyavagamyate
so 'yaṃ vyākṛtāvyākṛtarūpaḥ saṃsāro 'vidyāviṣayaḥ;kriyākārakaphalātmakatayā ātmarūpatvenādhyāropitaḥ avidyayaiva mūrtāmūrtatadvāsanātmakaḥ
ato 'smātkriyākārakaphalabhedasvarūpād etāvadidamiti sādhyasādhanarūpādviraktasya kāmādidoṣakarmabījabhūtāvidyānivṛttaye rajjvāmiva sarpavijñānāpanayāya brahmavidyā ārabhyate
tathā ca mantraḥ-"aditirdyairaditirantarikṣamaditirmātā sa pitā"(yajuḥ.saṃ.25 / 23) ityādiḥ
vidyāprakaratvāccāsya
mervādijñānavatparamātmajñāne prayojanābhāvādayuktamiti cet? na,"brahmavidāpnoti param" "brahmavidāpnoti param bhidyate hṛdayagranthiḥ" iti phalaśravaṇāt, saṃsārabījāvidyādidoṣanivṛttidarśanācca
yathā svargakāmādidoṣavato darśapūrṇamāsādīni kāmyāni karmāṇi vihitāni tathā sarvānarthabījāvidyādidoṣavatastajjaniteṣṭāniṣṭaprāptiparihārarāgadveṣādidoṣavataśca tatpreritāviśeṣapravṛtteriṣṭāniṣṭaprāptiparihārārthino nityāni karmāṇi vidhīyante, na kevalaṃ śāstranimittānyeva
avyākṛtāttu yatparaṃ paramātmākhyaṃ vidyāviṣayam anāmarūpakarmātmakam"neti neti" iti itarapratyākhyānenopasaṃhariṣyati pṛthak
"prāṇo bṛhatī prāṇa ṛca ityeva vidyāt"iti śrutyantarāt
tasya prajāpateryadbhayaṃ tatkevalāvidyānimittameva paramārthadarśane 'nupapannamityāha- kasmāddhyabheṣyat kimityasau bhītavānparamārthanirūpaṇāyāṃ bhayamanupapannamevetyabhiprāyaḥ
tanna tathā vidyāt, yasmādetasyaiva prajāpateḥ sā visṛṣṭirdevabhedaḥ sarva eṣa u hyeva prajāpatireva prāṇaḥ sarve devāḥ
evamagnīṣomātmakaṃ jagadātmatvena paśyanta kenaciddoṣeṇa lipyate, prajāpatiśca bhavati
athaitasyaiva sādhyasādhanalakṣaṇasya vyākṛtasya jagato vyākaraṇātprāgbījāvasthā yā tāṃ nirdidijñatyaṅkurādikāryānumitāmiva vṛkṣasya, karmabījo 'vidyākṣetro hyasau saṃsāravṛkṣaḥ samūla uddhartavya iti
idaṃ śuklamidaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vā rūpamasyetīdaṃ rūpaḥ
"ātmānastu kāmāya"(bṛ.u.2 / 4 / 5) ityātmārthaḥ tvaśruterayukta iti cenna,"yatra vā anyadiva syāt"ityavidyāviṣayātmārthatvābhyupagamāt tatkena kaṃ paśyet (bṛ.u.4 / 5 / 15) neha nānāsti kiñcana (bṛ.u.4 / 4 / 19) tatra ko mohaḥ kaḥ śokaḥ ekatvamanupaśyataḥ (īśā.7) ityādinā vidyāviṣaye tatpratiṣedhācca nātmadharmatvam
neti neti asthūlam ekamevādvitīyam (chā.u.6 / 2 / 1) aśanāyādyatītaḥ ityevamādivākyānām upāsyātmasvarūpaviśeṣasamarpaṇenopayogaḥṣa phalaṃ ca mokṣo 'vidyānivṛttirvā
evamihāpyātmano 'lābho 'vidyāmātravyavadhānam
tathehāpyabrahmatvamasarvatvaṃ cāvidyākṛtameva nivartyatāṃ brahmavidyayā
brahmaṇyavidyānupapattiriti cet? na, brahmaṇi vidyāvidhānāt
bhavatvevaṃ nāvidyākartṛ bhrāntaṃ ca brahma
kiṃntu naivābrahmāvidyākartā cetano bhrānto 'nya iṣyate
"puṇyaṃ vai puṇyena karmaṇā bhavati"(bṛ.u.3 / 2 / 13) "taṃ vidyākarmaṇī samanvārabhete" ityevamādiśrutismṛtinyāyebhyaḥ parasmādvilakṣaṇo 'nyaḥ saṃsāryavagamyate
nedānīmaidaṃyugīnānāṃ viśeṣato manuṣyāṇām, alpavīryatvāditi syātkasyacidbuddhiḥ, tadutthāpanāyāha- tadidaṃ prakṛtaṃ brahma yatsarvabhūtānupraviṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭikriyādiliṅgam, etarhyetasminnapi vartamānakāle yaḥ kaścidvyāvṛttabāhyautsukya ātmānamevaivaṃ veda'ahaṃ brahmāsmi'iti apohyopādhijanitabhrāntivijñānādhyāropitānviśeṣān saṃsāradharmānāgandhitamanantaramabāhyaṃ brahyevāhamasmi kevalamiti-so 'vidyākṛtāsarvatvanivṛtterbrahāvijhānādidaṃ sarva bhavati
brahyāvidyāphalaprāpyau vidhnakaraṇe devādaya īśata iti kā śaḍkā? ityucyate-devādīnprati ṛṇavattvānmartyānām
na;avidyāpagamamātratvād brahmaprāptiphalasya - yaduktaṃ brahmaprāptiphalaṃ prati devā vighnaṃ kuryuriti, tatra na devānāṃ vighnakaraṇe sāmarthyam;kasmāt? vidyākālānantaritatvād brahmaprāptiphalasya
brahmavidyāsamakālamevāvidyāmātravyavadhānāpagamācchuktikāyā iva rajatābhāsāyāḥ śuktikātvamityavocāma
na tviha vidyāsamakāla ātmabhūte deśakālanimittānantarite, avasarānupapatteḥ
evaṃ tarhi vidyāpratyayasantatyabhāvād viparītapratyayatatkāryayośca darśanād antya evātmapratyayo 'vidyānivartako na tu pūrva iti
evaṃ tarhi santato 'vidyānivartako na vicchinna iti
na hi jīvanādihetuke pratyaye sati vidyāpratyayasantatirupapadyate, virodhāt
prathamā vidyāpratyayasantatirmaraṇakālāntā veti viśeṣābhāvāt, ādyantayoḥ pratyayoḥ pūrvoktau doṣau prasajyeyātām
ya evāvidyādidoṣanivṛttiphalakṛtpratyaya ādyo 'ntyaḥ santato 'santato vā sa eva vidyetyabhyupagamānna codyasyāvatāragandho 'pyasti
kiñca, na ca viparītapratyayo vidyāvata utpadyate, nirviṣayatvāt
kvacittu vidyāyāḥ pūrvotpannaviparītapratyayajanitasaṃskārebhyo viparītapratyayāvabhāsāḥ smṛtayo jāyamānāviparītapratyayabhrāntimakasmātkurvanti;yathā vijñātadigvibhāgasyāpyakasmāddigviparyayavibhramaḥ
ananyatsadvastvātmākhyaṃ yatrāvidyāyāṃ satyāmanyadivasyāttimirakṛtadvitīyacandravat, tatrāvidyākṛtānekakārakāpekṣaṃ darśanādikarma tatkṛtaṃ phalaṃ ca darśayati,"tatrānyo 'nyatpaśyet"ityādinā
etasya hyaviduṣo varṇāśramādipravibhāgavato 'dhikṛtasya karmaṇo vidyāsahitasya kevalasya ca śāstroktasya kāryaṃ manuṣyatvādiko brahmānta utkarṣaḥ
sarvāhīyamupaniṣad vidyāvidyāvibhāgapradarśanenaivopakṣīṇā
tac chreyo rūpam atyasṛjata kṣatraṃ, yāny etāni devatrā kṣatrāṇīndro varuṇaḥ somo rudraḥ parjanyo yamo mṛtyur īśāna iti
kāni punastāni? ityāhatatrābhipiktā eva viśeṣato nirdiśyante-indro devānāṃ rājā, varuṇo yādasām, somo brāhmaṇānām, rudraḥ paśūnām, parjanyo vidyudādīnām, yamaḥ pitṝṇām, mṛtyurogādīnām, īśānobhāsām-ityevamādīni deveṣukṣatrāṇi
yathā ca loke vedo 'nanukto 'nadhītaḥ karmādyavabodhakatvena na bhunakti, anyadvā laukikaṃ kṛṣyādi karmākṛtaṃ svātmanānabhivyañjitam ātmīyaphalapradānena na bhunakti, evamātmā svo lokaḥ svenaiva nityātmasvarūpeṇānabhivyañjito 'vidyādi prahāṇena na bhunaktyeva
tanna, kṛtasya kṣayavattvāt;ityetadāha - yadiha vai saṃsāre 'dbhutavatkaścinmahātmāpi, anevaṃvit-svaṃ lokaṃ yathoktena vidhinā avidvān, mahadbahu aśvamedhādi puṇyaṃ karma iṣṭaphalameva nairantaryeṇa karoti,'anenaivānantyaṃ mama bhaviṣyati'iti, tatkarma hāsyāvidyāvato 'vidyājanitakāmahetutvāt svapnadarśanavibhramodbhūtavibhūtivadantato 'nte phalopabhogasya kṣīyata eva
svātmalokopāsakasya viduṣo vidyāsaṃyogātkarmaiva na kṣīyata ityapare varṣayanti
brahma vidvāṃścettasmātpaśubhāvātkartavyatābandhanarūpātpratimucyate, kenāyaṃ kāritaḥ karmavandhanādhikāre 'vaśa iva pravartate, na punastadvimokṣṇopāye vidyādhikāra iti nanūktaṃ devā rakṣantīti
ātmaiva svābhāviko 'vidvānkāryakaraṇasaṅghātalakṣaṇo varṇī, agre prāgdārasambandhāt,ātmetyabhidhīyate;tasmādātmanaḥ pṛthagbhūtaṃ kāmyamānaṃ jāyādibhedarūpaṃ nāsīt;sa evaika āsīt - jāyādyeṣaṇābījabhūtā vidyāvāneka evāsīt
etadeva ca vidyāprakaraṇe madhuvidyāyāṃ vakṣyāmaḥ -'sarvaṃ sarvasya kāryaṃ madhu'ityātmaikatvavijñānārtham
na tathā vidyāt
sarvo hyaṃ vyaktāvyaktalakṣaṇaḥ saṃsāro 'suddho 'nityaḥ sādhyasādhanarūpo duḥkho 'vidyāviṣaya ityetasmādviraktasya brahmavidyā ārabdhavyeti
yadyapi dvitvaṃ hutaprahutayoḥ sambhavati, tathāpi śrautayoreva tu darśapūrṇamāsayordevānnatvaṃ prasiddhataram, mantra prakāśitatvāt
ityevaṃ brāhmaṇavādā āhuḥ, na tathā vidyānna tathā draṣṭavyam;yadahareva juhoti tadahaḥ punarmṛtyumapajayati, na saṃvatsarābhyāsamapekṣate
vidyākarmaṇorlokajayahetutvaṃ svātmapratilābhenaiva bhavatīti prasiddham
na tathā vidyākarmabhyāṃ devalokapitṛlokau svarūpalābhasattāmātreṇa;na hi vidyākarmaṇī svarūpalābhavyatirekeṇa putravadvyāpārāntarāpekṣayā lokajayahetutvaṃ pratipadyete
tatremaṃ mantraṃ saṃkṣepato vyācaṣṭa brāhmaṇam - prāṇādvā eṣa sūrya udeti prāṇe 'stameti
ūrdhvaṃ vidyāviṣaya ātmādhigantavya ithi caturthaṃ ārabhyate

tatrāvidyāviṣaye vaktavyaṃ sarvamuktam
vidyāviṣayastvātmā kevala upanyasto na nirṇītaḥ
atastadbrahma vidyāviṣayabhūtaṃ jñāpayitavyaṃ yāthātmyataḥ
tathā kauṣītakināmeva"na vācaṃ vijijñāsīta vaktāraṃ vidyāt"ityādinā vāgādikaraṇairvyāvṛttasya kartureva veditavyatāṃ darśayati
nāvidyāgocarāsadvastuviṣayamiti na pravartate yathā kāmyeṣu
vidyāvatāmeva karmādhikāra iti cet? na, brahmaikatvavidyāyāṃ karmādhikāravirodhasyoktatvāt
yat kṛṣṇaṃ tenāgnir
kiṃ punastad yaśaḥ? prāṇā vai yaśo viśvarūpam-prāṇāḥ śrotrādayo vāyavaśca marutaḥ saptadhā teṣu prasṛtā yaśaḥ-ityetadāha mantraḥ, śabdādijñānahetutvāt
tasyāsata ṛṣayaḥ sapta tīra iti-prāṇāḥ parispandātmakāḥ, ta eva ca ṛṣayaḥ, prāṇāvetadāha mantraḥ
aupaniṣadaṃmanyā api kecitprakriyāṃ racayanti-mūrtāmūrtarāśirekaḥ, paramātmarāśiruttamaḥ, tābhyāmanyo 'yaṃ madhyamaḥ kila tṛtīyaḥ kartrā bhoktrāvijñānamayena ajātaśatrupratibodhitena saha vidyākarmapūrvaprajñāsamudāyaḥ;prayoktā karmarāśiḥ, prayojyaḥ pūrvokto mūrtāmūrtabhūtarāśiḥ sādhanaṃ ceti
etasmādavidyāviṣayādviraktasya pratyagātmaviṣayabrahmavidyāyāmadhikāraḥ kathaṃ nāma syāditi-tṛtīye 'dhyāye upasaṃhṛtaḥ samasto 'vidyāviṣayaḥ
asyā brahmavidyāyā aṅgatvena saṃnyāso vidhitsitaḥ, jāyāputravittādilakṣaṇaṃ pāṅktaṃ karmāvidyāviṣayaṃ yasmānnātmaprāptisādhanam; anyasādhanaṃ hyanyasmai phalasādhanāya prayujyamānaṃ pratikūlaṃ bhavati
kecittu brahmavido 'pyeṣaṇāsambandhaṃ varṇayanti, tairbṛhadāraṇyakaṃ na śrutam; putrādyeṣaṇānāmavidvadviṣayatvam; vidyāviṣaye ca-"yeṣāṃ no 'yamātmāyaṃ lokaḥ"ityataḥ"kiṃ prajayā kariṣyāmaḥ"ityeṣa vibhāgastairna śrutaḥ śrutyā kṛtaḥ; sarvakriyākārakaphalopamardasvarūpāyāṃ ca vidyāyāṃ satyām, saha kāryeṇāvidyāyā anupapattilakṣaṇaśca virodhastairna vijñātaḥ
vyāsavākyaṃ ca tairna śrutam; karmavidyāsvarūpayorvidyāvidyātmakayoḥ pratikūlavartanaṃ virodhaḥ;
evaṃ sarvāsāṃ vidyānāṃ hṛdayam ekāyanam
yathāyaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ, evameva vā are maitreyidaṃ paramātmākhyaṃ mahadbhūtam-yasmānmahato bhūtādavidyayā paricchinnā satī kāryakaraṇopādhisambandhātkhilyamāvamāpannāsi, martyā janmamaraṇāśanāyāpipāsādisaṃsāradharmavatyasi, nāmarūpakāryātmikā-amuṣyānva yāhamiti, sa khilyabhāvastava kāryakaraṇabhūnopādhisamparkabhrāntijanito mahati bhūte svayonau mahāsamudrasyānīye paramātmani ajare 'mare 'bhaye śudve saindhavavanavadekarase prajñānaghane 'nante 'pāre nirantare 'vidyājanitabhrāntimedavarjite praveśitaḥ
tasminpraviṣṭe svayonigraste khilyabhāve 'vidyākṛte bhedabhāve praṇāśite-idamekamadvaitaṃ mahadbhūtam mahacca tad bhūtaṃ ca mahadbhūtaṃ sarvamahattaratvādākāśādikāraṇatvācca
bhūrādayaḥ, sarve praṇā vāgādayaḥ, sarva eta ātmāno jalacandravat pratiśarīrānupraveśino 'vidyākalpitāḥ, sarvaṃ jagadasmin samarpitam
tasmāttatra ya eva śrutyācāryadarśitamārgānusāriṇaḥ, ta evāvidyāyāḥ pāramadhigacchanti
api caivaṃ stutā brahmavidyā sarvo hi loko dvandvārāmaḥ"sa vai naiva reme tasmādekākī na ramate"iti śruteḥ
tanyaturiva vṛrṣṭi yathā parjanyo vṛrṣṭi prakāśayati stanayitnvādiśabdaiḥ, tadvadahaṃ yuvayoḥ krūraṃ karma āviṣkṛṇomīti sambandhaḥ
mantraścāyaṃ svādhyāyārtho japārthaśca

tasmādanyapareṇāpi śāstreṇa vidyāprāptyupāyadānapradarśanārthā'khyāyikā'rabdhā
api ca tadvidyasaṃyogastaiśva saha vādakaraṇaṃ vidyāprāptyupāyo nyāyavidyāyāṃ dṛṣṭaḥ
sa hovāca -- namo vayaṃ brahmiṣṭhāya kurmo gokāmā eva vayaṃ sma iti
advaitārthatve vaidikānāṃ karmaṇāṃ vidyāsahitānām anyaspānuniṣpāditatve pramāṇānupapattiḥ
atha jīvannevāvidyāmātrāvaśiṣṭo bhojyādapāvṛtta iti parikalpyate tattu kiṃnimittamiti vaktavyam
yattu kaiściducyate vidyāsahitaṃ karma nirabhisaṃdhi mantraśarkarādiyuktaviṣadadhyādivatkāryāntaramārabhata iti
vidyāsaṃyuktasya tu nirabhisaṃdherbhavatyanyathā svabhāvaḥ
dṛṣṭaṃ hyanyaśaktitvena nirjñātānāmapi padārthānāṃ viṣadadhyādīnāṃ vidyāmantraśarkarādisaṃyuktānāmanyaviṣaye sāmathyam
yatpunaruktaṃ vidyāmantraśarkarādisaṃyuktaviṣadadadhyādivannityāni kāryāntaramārabhanta iti
nirabhisaṃdheḥ karmaṇo vidyāsaṃyuktasya viśiṣṭakāryāntarārambhe na kaścidvirodhaḥ
so 'haṃ vidyāsampanno labdhāgamo gandharvāt tvā tvāṃ pṛcchāmi yājñavalkya-kva pārikṣitā abhavantat tvaṃ kiṃ jānāsi? he yājñavalkya'kathaya pṛcchāmi kva pārikṣitā abhavanniti
vittaiṣaṇāyāśca karmasādhanasya gavāderupādānamanena karma kṛtvā pitṛlokaṃ jeṣyāmīti vidyāsaṃyuktena vā devalokaṃ kevalayā vā hiraṇyagarbhavidyayā daivena vittena devalokam
na ca vidyāvidye ekasya puruṣasya yaha bhavato virodhāttamaḥ prakāśāviva

sa eṣa bījāṅkurādivadavidyākṛtaḥ saṃsāra ātmani kriyākārakaphalādhyāropalakṣaṇo 'nādirananto 'narthaḥ, ityetasmādviraktasyāvidyānivṛttaye tadviparītabrahmavidyāpratipattyarthopaniṣadārabhyate
vidyāprakaraṇe cāmnānāt karmāntare ca sampādanadarśanād vijñānāt tatphalaprāptirastītyavagamyate
so 'yaṃ vyākṛtāvyākṛtarūpaḥ saṃsāro 'vidyāviṣayaḥ;kriyākārakaphalātmakatayā ātmarūpatvenādhyāropitaḥ avidyayaiva mūrtāmūrtatadvāsanātmakaḥ
ato 'smātkriyākārakaphalabhedasvarūpād etāvadidamiti sādhyasādhanarūpādviraktasya kāmādidoṣakarmabījabhūtāvidyānivṛttaye rajjvāmiva sarpavijñānāpanayāya brahmavidyā ārabhyate

vidyāprakaratvāccāsya
mervādijñānavatparamātmajñāne prayojanābhāvādayuktamiti cet? na,"brahmavidāpnoti param" "brahmavidāpnoti param bhidyate hṛdayagranthiḥ" iti phalaśravaṇāt, saṃsārabījāvidyādidoṣanivṛttidarśanācca
yathā svargakāmādidoṣavato darśapūrṇamāsādīni kāmyāni karmāṇi vihitāni tathā sarvānarthabījāvidyādidoṣavatastajjaniteṣṭāniṣṭaprāptiparihārarāgadveṣādidoṣavataśca tatpreritāviśeṣapravṛtteriṣṭāniṣṭaprāptiparihārārthino nityāni karmāṇi vidhīyante, na kevalaṃ śāstranimittānyeva
avyākṛtāttu yatparaṃ paramātmākhyaṃ vidyāviṣayam anāmarūpakarmātmakam"neti neti" iti itarapratyākhyānenopasaṃhariṣyati pṛthak
"prāṇo bṛhatī prāṇa ṛca ityeva vidyāt"iti śrutyantarāt
tasya prajāpateryadbhayaṃ tatkevalāvidyānimittameva paramārthadarśane 'nupapannamityāha- kasmāddhyabheṣyat kimityasau bhītavānparamārthanirūpaṇāyāṃ bhayamanupapannamevetyabhiprāyaḥ
tanna tathā vidyāt, yasmādetasyaiva prajāpateḥ sā visṛṣṭirdevabhedaḥ sarva eṣa u hyeva prajāpatireva prāṇaḥ sarve devāḥ
evamagnīṣomātmakaṃ jagadātmatvena paśyanta kenaciddoṣeṇa lipyate, prajāpatiśca bhavati
athaitasyaiva sādhyasādhanalakṣaṇasya vyākṛtasya jagato vyākaraṇātprāgbījāvasthā yā tāṃ nirdidijñatyaṅkurādikāryānumitāmiva vṛkṣasya, karmabījo 'vidyākṣetro hyasau saṃsāravṛkṣaḥ samūla uddhartavya iti
idaṃ śuklamidaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vā rūpamasyetīdaṃ rūpaḥ
"ātmānastu kāmāya"(bṛ.u.2 / 4 / 5) ityātmārthaḥ tvaśruterayukta iti cenna,"yatra vā anyadiva syāt"ityavidyāviṣayātmārthatvābhyupagamāt tatkena kaṃ paśyet (bṛ.u.4 / 5 / 15) neha nānāsti kiñcana (bṛ.u.4 / 4 / 19) tatra ko mohaḥ kaḥ śokaḥ ekatvamanupaśyataḥ (īśā.7) ityādinā vidyāviṣaye tatpratiṣedhācca nātmadharmatvam
neti neti asthūlam ekamevādvitīyam (chā.u.6 / 2 / 1) aśanāyādyatītaḥ ityevamādivākyānām upāsyātmasvarūpaviśeṣasamarpaṇenopayogaḥṣa phalaṃ ca mokṣo 'vidyānivṛttirvā
evamihāpyātmano 'lābho 'vidyāmātravyavadhānam
tathehāpyabrahmatvamasarvatvaṃ cāvidyākṛtameva nivartyatāṃ brahmavidyayā
brahmaṇyavidyānupapattiriti cet? na, brahmaṇi vidyāvidhānāt
bhavatvevaṃ nāvidyākartṛ bhrāntaṃ ca brahma
kiṃntu naivābrahmāvidyākartā cetano bhrānto 'nya iṣyate
"puṇyaṃ vai puṇyena karmaṇā bhavati"(bṛ.u.3 / 2 / 13) "taṃ vidyākarmaṇī samanvārabhete" ityevamādiśrutismṛtinyāyebhyaḥ parasmādvilakṣaṇo 'nyaḥ saṃsāryavagamyate
nedānīmaidaṃyugīnānāṃ viśeṣato manuṣyāṇām, alpavīryatvāditi syātkasyacidbuddhiḥ, tadutthāpanāyāha- tadidaṃ prakṛtaṃ brahma yatsarvabhūtānupraviṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭikriyādiliṅgam, etarhyetasminnapi vartamānakāle yaḥ kaścidvyāvṛttabāhyautsukya ātmānamevaivaṃ veda'ahaṃ brahmāsmi'iti apohyopādhijanitabhrāntivijñānādhyāropitānviśeṣān saṃsāradharmānāgandhitamanantaramabāhyaṃ brahyevāhamasmi kevalamiti-so 'vidyākṛtāsarvatvanivṛtterbrahāvijhānādidaṃ sarva bhavati
brahyāvidyāphalaprāpyau vidhnakaraṇe devādaya īśata iti kā śaḍkā? ityucyate-devādīnprati ṛṇavattvānmartyānām
na;avidyāpagamamātratvād brahmaprāptiphalasya - yaduktaṃ brahmaprāptiphalaṃ prati devā vighnaṃ kuryuriti, tatra na devānāṃ vighnakaraṇe sāmarthyam;kasmāt? vidyākālānantaritatvād brahmaprāptiphalasya
brahmavidyāsamakālamevāvidyāmātravyavadhānāpagamācchuktikāyā iva rajatābhāsāyāḥ śuktikātvamityavocāma
na tviha vidyāsamakāla ātmabhūte deśakālanimittānantarite, avasarānupapatteḥ
evaṃ tarhi vidyāpratyayasantatyabhāvād viparītapratyayatatkāryayośca darśanād antya evātmapratyayo 'vidyānivartako na tu pūrva iti
evaṃ tarhi santato 'vidyānivartako na vicchinna iti
na hi jīvanādihetuke pratyaye sati vidyāpratyayasantatirupapadyate, virodhāt
prathamā vidyāpratyayasantatirmaraṇakālāntā veti viśeṣābhāvāt, ādyantayoḥ pratyayoḥ pūrvoktau doṣau prasajyeyātām
ya evāvidyādidoṣanivṛttiphalakṛtpratyaya ādyo 'ntyaḥ santato 'santato vā sa eva vidyetyabhyupagamānna codyasyāvatāragandho 'pyasti
kiñca, na ca viparītapratyayo vidyāvata utpadyate, nirviṣayatvāt
kvacittu vidyāyāḥ pūrvotpannaviparītapratyayajanitasaṃskārebhyo viparītapratyayāvabhāsāḥ smṛtayo jāyamānāviparītapratyayabhrāntimakasmātkurvanti;yathā vijñātadigvibhāgasyāpyakasmāddigviparyayavibhramaḥ
ananyatsadvastvātmākhyaṃ yatrāvidyāyāṃ satyāmanyadivasyāttimirakṛtadvitīyacandravat, tatrāvidyākṛtānekakārakāpekṣaṃ darśanādikarma tatkṛtaṃ phalaṃ ca darśayati,"tatrānyo 'nyatpaśyet"ityādinā
etasya hyaviduṣo varṇāśramādipravibhāgavato 'dhikṛtasya karmaṇo vidyāsahitasya kevalasya ca śāstroktasya kāryaṃ manuṣyatvādiko brahmānta utkarṣaḥ
sarvāhīyamupaniṣad vidyāvidyāvibhāgapradarśanenaivopakṣīṇā
tac chreyo rūpam atyasṛjata kṣatraṃ, yāny etāni devatrā kṣatrāṇīndro varuṇaḥ somo rudraḥ parjanyo yamo mṛtyur īśāna iti
kāni punastāni? ityāhatatrābhipiktā eva viśeṣato nirdiśyante-indro devānāṃ rājā, varuṇo yādasām, somo brāhmaṇānām, rudraḥ paśūnām, parjanyo vidyudādīnām, yamaḥ pitṝṇām, mṛtyurogādīnām, īśānobhāsām-ityevamādīni deveṣukṣatrāṇi
yathā ca loke vedo 'nanukto 'nadhītaḥ karmādyavabodhakatvena na bhunakti, anyadvā laukikaṃ kṛṣyādi karmākṛtaṃ svātmanānabhivyañjitam ātmīyaphalapradānena na bhunakti, evamātmā svo lokaḥ svenaiva nityātmasvarūpeṇānabhivyañjito 'vidyādi prahāṇena na bhunaktyeva
tanna, kṛtasya kṣayavattvāt;ityetadāha - yadiha vai saṃsāre 'dbhutavatkaścinmahātmāpi, anevaṃvit-svaṃ lokaṃ yathoktena vidhinā avidvān, mahadbahu aśvamedhādi puṇyaṃ karma iṣṭaphalameva nairantaryeṇa karoti,'anenaivānantyaṃ mama bhaviṣyati'iti, tatkarma hāsyāvidyāvato 'vidyājanitakāmahetutvāt svapnadarśanavibhramodbhūtavibhūtivadantato 'nte phalopabhogasya kṣīyata eva
svātmalokopāsakasya viduṣo vidyāsaṃyogātkarmaiva na kṣīyata ityapare varṣayanti
brahma vidvāṃścettasmātpaśubhāvātkartavyatābandhanarūpātpratimucyate, kenāyaṃ kāritaḥ karmavandhanādhikāre 'vaśa iva pravartate, na punastadvimokṣṇopāye vidyādhikāra iti nanūktaṃ devā rakṣantīti
ātmaiva svābhāviko 'vidvānkāryakaraṇasaṅghātalakṣaṇo varṇī, agre prāgdārasambandhāt,ātmetyabhidhīyate;tasmādātmanaḥ pṛthagbhūtaṃ kāmyamānaṃ jāyādibhedarūpaṃ nāsīt;sa evaika āsīt - jāyādyeṣaṇābījabhūtā vidyāvāneka evāsīt
etadeva ca vidyāprakaraṇe madhuvidyāyāṃ vakṣyāmaḥ -'sarvaṃ sarvasya kāryaṃ madhu'ityātmaikatvavijñānārtham
na tathā vidyāt
sarvo hyaṃ vyaktāvyaktalakṣaṇaḥ saṃsāro 'suddho 'nityaḥ sādhyasādhanarūpo duḥkho 'vidyāviṣaya ityetasmādviraktasya brahmavidyā ārabdhavyeti
yadyapi dvitvaṃ hutaprahutayoḥ sambhavati, tathāpi śrautayoreva tu darśapūrṇamāsayordevānnatvaṃ prasiddhataram, mantra prakāśitatvāt
ityevaṃ brāhmaṇavādā āhuḥ, na tathā vidyānna tathā draṣṭavyam;yadahareva juhoti tadahaḥ punarmṛtyumapajayati, na saṃvatsarābhyāsamapekṣate
vidyākarmaṇorlokajayahetutvaṃ svātmapratilābhenaiva bhavatīti prasiddham
na tathā vidyākarmabhyāṃ devalokapitṛlokau svarūpalābhasattāmātreṇa;na hi vidyākarmaṇī svarūpalābhavyatirekeṇa putravadvyāpārāntarāpekṣayā lokajayahetutvaṃ pratipadyete
tatremaṃ mantraṃ saṃkṣepato vyācaṣṭa brāhmaṇam - prāṇādvā eṣa sūrya udeti prāṇe 'stameti
ūrdhvaṃ vidyāviṣaya ātmādhigantavya ithi caturthaṃ ārabhyate
ātmānamevāvedahaṃ brahmāsmītyātmatattvamekaṃ vidyāviṣayaḥ
"ekadhaivānudraṣṭavyam" "mṛtyoḥ sa mṛtyumāpnoti ya iha nāneva paśyati"ityevamādibhiḥ pravibhatkau vidyāviṣayau sarvopaniṣatsu
tatra cāvidyāviṣayaḥ sarva eva sādhyasādhanādibhedaviśeṣaviniyogena vyākhyātaḥ-ā tṛtīyādhyāyaparisamāpteḥ

kālena bahunā kālīm uvācedaṃ kuleśvaraḥ
evaṃ samyagvidhānena rudraśaktiḥ svayambhunā
vīrāvalīti tena tvaṃ rudraśaktiḥ praśasyase
siddhair yā veṣṭitāṅgī parivṛtacaturaiḥ ṣaṣṭibhir yogivṛndair yuktā hṛtpaṅkajena ḍaralakasahajā pātu māṃ rudraśaktiḥ
parā mālinī rudramālārcite rudraśaktiḥ khagī siddhayogeśvarī
divyacaryānurūḍhair namaskāra oṃkārasvāhāsvadhākāravauṣaḍvaṣaṭ-
rudrāṇī rudraśākī ca gomukhī sumukhī tathā
vidyām abhayadātāraṃ laulyacāpalyavarjitam
ājñāyogaṃ kriyāmantraṃ muṣitvā yaḥ palāyate
oṃkāreṇa tu te guptā namaskāreṇa bhāmini
o-jā-pū-kā-kramān bhittvā vidyākubjapade sthitam
mudrā mantraṃ tathā bhāṣā sarvaṃ jānāti tattvataḥ
vidarbho mantra-m-ādau tu mantrānte vīranāyike
brahmasthaḥ sakalo mantra aṣṭatriṃśatkalair yutaḥ
pañcāvasthāprabhinnas tu tadā mantra-m ihocyate
sapta koṭyas tu vidyānāṃ mantrāṇām amitaujasām
aiṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya padaṃ caiva daśākṣaram
sarvāsāṃ caiva mātṝṇāṃ svāhāpraṇavasaṃyutam
namo mātṛgaṇāyeti triṃśakaṃ kathitaṃ sphuṭam
namo namaḥ aiṃ vicce svāhā triṃśam ekottaraṃ padam
padabhedas tu vidyāyā jñātavyaḥ sādhakena tu
vidyāyās tu prasaṅgena pañcapraṇavam uddhṛtam
sāmprataṃ śṛṇu kalyāṇi vidyāmāhātmyam uttamam
sapta varṇān dadec cādau madhye vidyāpadaṃ dadet
tasyāgre tu tato mantraṃ hutāśakaṇikākṛtim
uccāreta tato mantraṃ śabdarūpaṃ hṛdi priye
ātmā manaś ca mantraś ca śivaḥ śaktis tathaiva ca
brahmā viṣṇus tathā rudra īśvaro 'tha sadāśivaḥ
mantramudrāgaṇo hy atra vidyāmaṇḍalakādikam
kavacaṃ yasyā mahādevyā mantramāyātmakaṃ mahat
rephasaham idaṃ kūṭaṃ vidyāsaptamakaṃ padam
dvisaptakaṃ ca kavacaṃ netraṃ saptākṣaraṃ śubham
mantraṃ caiva tathātmānam ekīkṛtya trayaṃ budhaḥ
sampūjya yoginīṣaṭkaṃ rāmaṇīśirasānvitam
rakāraṃ tu lalāṭasthaṃ japen mantraṃ punaḥ punaḥ
smaraṇāt kevalo mantraḥ sukham utpādayed yathā
aghorān na paro mantraḥ kasmāc cūlīgatas tu saḥ
siddhārthayogayuktānām aiṃpādādyantayojitam
ādyakṣaraṃ japen mantraṃ punar ādyaṃ niyojayet
brahmaṃ bhittvā tato viṣṇuṃ rudram īśvaram eva ca
sarvavighnopaśamanaṃ mantraṃ tryakṣaram uttamam
nyastaṃ sarvāṅgikaṃ mantraṃ bhairavākārasaṃsthitam
sa eva līyate viṣṇor viṣṇu rudrasamāśritaḥ
sa eva līyate māyā sā ca viṣṇuḥ prakīrtitā
sa viṣṇuḥ śivatāṃ yāti setuṃ bhittvā kuleśvari
vidyārājeti vikhyāto mantrarājeti kathyate
dhāraṇīyaṃ sadā gātre yathāvat pravadāmy aham
puṣpeṇa guḍikāṃ kṛtvā mantraṃ bhūrje samālikhet
sarvaṃ kṣasthaṃ paraṃ mantraṃ sarvarakṣākaraṃ param
dhāraṇīyā prayatnena śivalokam avāpnuyāt
guruvaktrāt tu vijñeyo madhye oṃkāramadhyagam
sarvajñaṃ paramaṃ mantraṃ muktidaṃ vyādhināśanam
jarāmṛtyuharaṃ devi vidyārājeti kīrtitam
kavacaṃ tu samākhyātam asiddhabhedakṛd bhavet
kavacaṃ tu samākhyātaṃ śṛṇu netraṃ yathāsthitam
tayā vidyābhiṣekaṃ tu nyastavyā kalaśe tu sā
bahurūpasamākīrṇaṃ vidyāguṇavibhūṣitam
candrarūpaṃ yadā paśyet tārāmaṇḍalamadhyataḥ
tejastattvaṃ tu taṃ devi rudraśaktibhir āvṛtam

kālītantroktavidhinā saptāhaṃ japapūjanam
tatraiva prajapen mantraṃ sarvavandyanavātmakam
tasyopari japen mantraṃ mahāmāyāṃ hi caṇḍike
vihāre yo bhavet putro gaṇeśaḥ sa ca kīrtitaḥ
mahāśaṅkhaṃ vinā devi na mantraḥ siddhidāyakaḥ
ṣaḍakṣaraṃ mahāmantraṃ gajāntakasahasrakam
tasyopari japen mantraṃ sarvavandyanavātmakam
etan mantraṃ maheśāni gajāntakasahasrakam
cāmuṇḍāyā mahāmantraṃ kīdṛśaṃ parameśvara
kālībījayugaṃ devi kūrcabījaṃ tataḥ param
pūjānte prajapen mantraṃ trisahasraṃ varānane
tathā rātrau japen mantraṃ kulaśaktisamanvitam
namo 'ntena tu deveśi āsanaṃ ca samarcayet
samāpte tu vilomena punar mantraṃ śataṃ japet
śṛṇu mantraṃ pravakṣyāmi trailokyeṣu ca durlabham
navākṣaraṃ mahāmantraṃ japed ādau śataṃ priye
viparītaṃ mahāmantraṃ pāṭhānte tu śataṃ japet
oṃ saptaśatīmahāstotrasya medhātithiṛṣir gāyatryanuṣṭubbṛhatīpaṃktitriṣtubjagatyaś chandāṃsi mahākālīmahālakṣmīmahāsarasvīdevatāstavakaṃ aiṃ hrīṃ klīṃ bījāni kṣrauṃ śaktiḥ mamāmukakāmasiddhyarthe viniyogaḥ
mahāmantraṃ śrutaṃ nātha vāmakeśvarayāmale
kathitaṃ ca mayā pūrvaṃ mantraṃ śṛṇu varānane
vāgbījaṃ ca mahāmāyāṃ viṣṇuśaktiṃ samuccaret
śrīpādukāṃ samuccārya pūjayāmi namas tataḥ
stutiṃ ca kavacaṃ nātha śrotum icchāmi sāmpratam
śrīguroḥ kavacaṃ stotraṃ tvayā proktaṃ purā prabho
idānīṃ strīguroḥ stotraṃ kavacaṃ mayi kathyatām
namas te devadeveśi namas te harapūjite
brahmavidyāsvarūpāyai tasyai nityaṃ namo namaḥ
yayā cakṣur unmīlitaṃ tasyai nityaṃ namo namaḥ
jñānadā mokṣadā nityā tasyai nityaṃ namo namaḥ
sadā vijñānadātrī ca tasyai nityaṃ namo namaḥ
mahāmokṣapradā devī tasyai nityaṃ namo namaḥ
triguṇātmasvarūpā ca tasyai nityaṃ namo namaḥ
svanāthaṃ ca samāliṅgya tasyai nityaṃ namo namaḥ
jñānavijñānadātrī ca tasyai nityaṃ namo namaḥ
stotraṃ samāptaṃ deveśi kavacaṃ śṛṇu sādaram
iti te kathitaṃ kānte kavacaṃ paramādbhutam
gurumantraṃ japitvā tu kavacaṃ prapaṭhed yadi
pūjākāle paṭhed yas tu kavacaṃ mantravigraham
samastamaṅgalaṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutam
samāptaṃ kavacaṃ devi kim anyac chrotum icchasi
śrīvidyāviṣaye nātha viśeṣo mayi kathyatām
śilāmadhye tathā cakraṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ param
pāradasya śatāṃśaikaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ na hi
imaṃ mantraṃ maheśāni prajaped auṣadhopari
ṣaḍakṣaraṃ mahāmantraṃ prāsādākhyaṃ manuṃ tataḥ
diksahasraṃ japen mantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ hunet priye
narākṛtiṃ guruṃ nātha mantraṃ varṇātmakaṃ tathā
vedoktaṃ caiva smṛtyuktaṃ mantraṃ na yojayet sudhīḥ
bāhumūlapramāṇena yajñasūtraṃ dvijātibhiḥ
dhāraṇīyaṃ prayatnena nānyad dairghyaṃ kadācana
dviguṇaṃ prajapen mantraṃ dviguṇaṃ homayet sudhīḥ
svayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ prokto yadi śambhuṃ prapūjayet
liṅgamadhye mahāvahniḥ saiva rudraḥ prakīrtitaḥ
tasmāl lakṣmīr vaiṣṇavī yā trivargadāyinī śivā
evaṃ mantraś cānyathā vā ceti bhrāntyā ca vātulaḥ
yadi mantraṃ hared devi śṛṇu sādhakalakṣaṇam
akṣare dūṣaṇaṃ hitvā punar mantraṃ prakāśayet
luptavarṇaṃ samutthāpya punar mantraṃ prakāśayet
ekoccāre japen mantraṃ lakṣam ekaṃ varānane
guruṇā lakṣajāpena tan mantraṃ śrāvayet tridhā

Mṛgendratantra, Vidyāpāda,
jñāyante anena vidyācaryākriyāyogā iti jñānaṃ śāstram
prasannena ca hariṇā navoditabhāsvadbhāsvaraṃ sarvabhūtābhibhāvukaṃ nārasiṃhaṃ kavacaṃ prayacchatā proktam
vede 'sti saṃhitā raudrī vācyā rudraś ca devatā
ā vo rājā tad vo varga ājyadohāni devavratāni caiṣā raudrī nāma saṃhitaitāṃ prayuñjāno rudraṃ prīṇāti
tatra tatra rudra eva devatā vācyarūpatayā śrūyate yam uddiśya
eṣa te rudra bhāgaḥ saha svasrāmbikayā taṃ juṣasva svāhā
avinirbhinnaśabdārthaṃ dhyāyed oṃkāram īśvaram
yo rudro viśvā bhuvanā viveśa tasmai rudrāya namo 'stu
ab2:4
athety ānuṣaṅgikasambandhādikathanād anantaraṃ vidyākhyaḥ pādaḥ prakramyate
kiṃ ca pāśajālam apohatīty apohatikriyākṣiptāḥ kriyācaryāyogapādāḥ patipaśupāśoktyākṣiptaś ca vidyāpāda iti pādacatuṣṭayopakṣepaḥ kṛtaḥ
ittham asyaiva padārthatrayasya vidyāpāde sthitasya caryādipādatrayeṇa viniyogo vibhajanam abhidhāsyate vakṣyate
om ity upapattyanupapattiparyālocanaparihāreṇa yady etad aṅgīkriyate kāmam avatiṣṭhatāṃ na tu prāmāṇikarītyā
cd:1
rājāno lokeśā indrādayaḥ teṣāṃ rājānaḥ śatarudrāḥ tadīśvarāṇāṃ maṇḍaliprabhṛtīnāmapyeta īśvarāḥ prabhavaḥ vidyāmaheśvarā iti yāvat

krīḍāvān eva bhagavān vidyākalāpaśusaṃjñakaṃ trividham api kāryam utpādayati anugṛhṇāti tirobhāvayati ca
yastu vidyāṃ guroradhikṛtya bahubhyaḥ samprayacchati anenāsya vidyāyā dānena guravaḥ śuśrūṣitā bhavanti
iha tu gāyatrīgrahaṇāt sadyojātādīnāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ
gāyatrīm iti karma
bhava iti vidyākalāpaśūnāṃ samastānāṃ grahaṇam
atra bhava iti vidyākalāpaśūnāmeva grahaṇam
krīḍāvāneva sa bhagavān vidyākalāpaśusaṃjñakaṃ trividhamapi kāryam utpādayan anugṛhṇāti tirobhāvayati cety ato devaḥ
atra rutasya bhayasya drāvaṇāt saṃyojanād rudraḥ tatra rutam abhilāpa ityanarthāntaram
uktaṃ hi / nānāvidhaiḥ kṛtairyasmād bhayaiśca vividhaistathā / saṃyojayati bhūtāni tasmād rudra iti smṛtaḥ
atra trividhena kāryeṇa vidyākalāpaśusaṃjñakena tatraiva sthityutpattipralayān prāpnuvatā kalitaṃ śobhitaśabditaṃ nabhastārābhir ivetyarthaḥ
atra sarvaśabdo vidyādikāryaniravaśeṣavācī draṣṭavyaḥ
kāmyaṃ vidyādikāryam
rudra iti vaiṣayikaṃ saṃnidhānam
te devapitaro rudraśaktyāṃ hāryadhāryakāryatvena vartante ādhīyante viṣaye vartanta ityarthaḥ
taducyate trividhasyāpi kāryasya rudre hāryadhāryakāryajñāpanārthaṃ kiṃca kālakriyāsvāhāsvadhāmantrānyatvadarśanād devapitṛyajanāpahṛtacittavyāvartanārthatvāc ca
tathā kuyajanāny agniṣṭomādīni
saṃgrahapratigrahahiṃsādiyuktena śraveṇābhinirvṛttidarśanāt pattrīrātrijadevatādisādhāraṇaphalatvād anityasātiśayasaṃkīrṇaphalatvāc ca kuyajanāny agniṣṭomādīni
vāmadevāya namo jyeṣṭhāya namo rudrāya namaḥ
brahmādibhūrjaparyantaṃ jagad etac carācaram / yataḥ kalayate rudraḥ kālarūpī tataḥ smṛtaḥ
balaṃ nāma dharmajñānavairāgyaiśvaryādharmājñānāvairāgyānaiśvaryāṇi icchādveṣaprayatnādīni vidyāvargaḥ rūpāṇi
vidyādikāryasya śaraṇāccharva ityucyate
sarvaṃ vidyādikāryaṃ rudrastham
taducyate 'tra rudra iti kāraṇāpadeśe
tathā rudraḥ samudro hi ananto bhāskaro nabhaḥ / ātmā brahma ca vāk caiva na śakyaṃ bhedadarśanam
āha kāni punastāni vidyāliṅgāni yair guptair vidyā guptā bhavati
na vāvyaktapretatvaṃ vā vidyāliṅgam
āha kiṃ vratamevaikaṃ vidyāliṅgaṃ gopyam āhosvid anyadapyasti neti
yasmādasya śrotrendriyavat pidhāyeti samyag jñānaprayoge sarvajñena bhagavatā vidyānugṛhītayā buddhyā pidhānamuktaṃ tasmādatra karaṇākhyā buddhyeti na jñānākhyā
pidhānamasya vidyānugṛhītā buddhiḥ
atredaṃ vidyājñānaprakaraṇaṃ parisamāptamiti
yantrāṇi agniṣṭomādīni māsopavāsādīni ca gṛhasthādīnāṃ śuddhivṛddhikarāṇi
rudra iti kālopadeśe
gṛhastho brahmacārī vānaprastho bhikṣur ekavedo dvivedas trivedaś caturvedo gāyatrīmātrasāro vānena vidhinā rudrasamīpaṃ prāptaḥ san na kaścid brāhmaṇaḥ punarāvartata ityarthaḥ
tan no rudraḥ pracodayāt
rudra iti kāraṇāpadeśe
cittasthityupadeśād yogārthaṃ vidyācaraṇopadeśād asaṅgayogiyuktātmājamaitrādīnāṃ cetane sambhavāt na tv acetaneṣu kāryakaraṇapradhānādiṣu
rudraḥ provāca tāvat
tatra rudra iti kāraṇāpadeśe
ṛcamiṣṭāmadhīyīta gāyatrīmātmayantritaḥ
yasmād āha gāyatrīm iti
āha atra gāyatrībahutvāt saṃdehaḥ
oṃkāramabhidhyāyīta
ityata oṃkāra evāvadhāryate dhyeyatvena na tu gāyatryādayaḥ
oṃkārasaṃnikṛṣṭacittena bhavitavyam
oṃkāra eva dhyeyo nānya ityarthaḥ / āha oṃkāro dhyeyaḥ
atra tu oṃkāro dhāryo nātmā kiṃtu ya evātmanyātmabhāvaḥ
āha oṃkāraḥ kiṃ parapa viṣṇurumā kumāraśca catasro 'rdhamātrā vā
tathā kṛtsnaṃ kāryaṃ vidyādyamīśata ityataḥ ṛṣiḥ
kīdṛśo vā oṃkāro dhyeyaḥ
prathamo vidyālābhastapaso lābho'tha devanityatvam / yogo guṇapravṛttirlābhāḥ pañceha vijñeyāḥ
vāsārtho lokaśca śūnyāgāraṃ tathā śmaśānaṃ ca / rudraśca pañca deśā niyataṃ siddhyarthamākhyātāḥ
atra labhate vindate āsādayatītyarthaḥ rudra iti kāraṇāpadeśe
tayā dharmasmṛticodanādisahitayā vidyāgṛhītayā buddhyā chedyaṃ sthāpyaṃ cetyarthaḥ
rudrasya rudratvaṃ pūrvoktam rudra ityaupaśleṣikaṃ saṃnidhānam
vidyādikāryasyeśanādīśaḥ
taducyate sarvasyeśānaḥ / sarvaśabdo vidyāprakṛter niravaśeṣavācī draṣṭavyaḥ
vidyānāṃ dharmārthakāmakaivalyatatsādhanaparāṇām īśānaḥ vidyānāmiti ṣaṣṭhībahuvacanam
āha kiṃ vidyānāmeveśānaḥ na tu vidyābhirye vidanti
āha atra kecid vidyābhūtavyatiriktaṃ brahmāṇamicchanti
bṛṃhayate yasmād vidyākalābhūtāni bṛhac ca tebhya ityato 'dhipatirbrahmā

provenance.rawSnippet:
brahmadīnāṃnamostaṃvā svāhāstaṃvābalirbhavet
prācyāṃ viṣṇuṃ prakurvīta yasya garbhagṛhesthitiḥ
śvetaṃ raktaṃ tathā pītaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ caiva catuṣṭayam
trīṇi cottamakaṃ vidyādutsedhaṃ navathā bhavet
viṣṇuśūlaṃ tu keśānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ paṭṭikameva ca
vakṣodaṇḍaśikhāmadhye bāhumūlagate śikhe
bāhumūlagatābhyāṃ tu vakṣodaṇḍaśikhāgatām
śikhā pūrvavaduddiṣṭā bāhumūlaśikhānvitā
bāhumūlaviśālārdhaṃ tyaktvā yāvattadantaram
gāyatrīmantramuccārya praṇavenādāyamantravit
medinīmantra muccārya caiśānyādiṣu pālikāḥ
pālikādīn prapūryaiva gāyatrīmantra muccaran
pakṣmavarma ca raktañca śvetaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca taijasam
tadhaiva vāmanetretu vaiṣṇavaṃ mantra muccaran
vedamantrajña ācāryo rakṣāmantraṃ samuccaran
"idaṃ viṣṇu'ssamuccārya samādāya samāhitaḥ
viṣṇuṃ ca puruṣaṃ satyamacyutaṃ cāniruddhakam
vidyārthināṃ ca bhaktānāmanyasya vibhavasya ca
taṃ viṣṇuṃ pūjayennityaṃ sarvasādhanasādhanam
viṣṇuṃ ca puruṣaṃ satyamacyutaṃ cāviruddhakam
rāmo rāmaśca rāmaśca kṛṣṇaḥ karkirime daśa
"akūpāraṃ kūrmarūpaṃ viṣṇuṃ ca vasudhādharam'
viṣṇuṃ' ceti tathā devaṃ yajñavārāhamāhvayet
tathā lakṣmīnṛsiṃhaṃ ca pātālanarasiṃhakam
"nārasiṃhaṃ taponāthaṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ mahābalam
viṣṇuṃ trivikramaṃ ceti trilokeśamataḥ param
"prahlādaṃ vīryavittaṃ ca viṣṇu bhaktaṃ mahābalam'
daśāvatāra kalpaḥ (rāmaḥ) bhārgavaḥ
sthāpayecchatrunāśāya rāmaṃ paraśudhāriṇam
madhyamaṃ daśatālena rāmaṃ dvibhujamācaret
"rāmaṃ ṛṣisutaṃ viṣṇuṃ paraśupāṇi'mitīrayet
ṣaṣṭidvigolagaṃ vidyādekatṣaṃśatribhāgīkam?
"rāmaṃ dāśarathiṃ viṣṇuṃ kākutstha'miti cāhvayet
"śriye jāta'śca sītāyā home mantra udīritaḥ
tasya dakṣiṇapārśvetu lakṣmīvadrohiṇīṃ caret
"rāmaṃ yaduvaraṃ viṣṇuṃ halāyudha'mitikramāt
daśāvatārakalpaḥ(kṛṣṇaḥ)
kṛṣṇaṃ ca bālavapuṣaṃ śyāmalaṃ pītavāsasam
navanītanaṭaṃ kuryāttathā kālīyamardanam
abhayaṃ bāhumānaṃ caturviṃśatiraṅgulam
evameva prakurvīta kālīyāhiphaṇopari
evaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prakurvīta jaganmohanavigraham
evaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prakurvīta veṇunādanaṭaṃ budhaḥ
evaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prakurvīta līlāmānuṣavigraham
eve kṛṣṇaṃ prakurvīta rājagopālavigraham
evaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prakurvīta govardhanadharaṃ harim
evaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prakurvīta pārthasārathivigraham
evaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prakurvīta bālagaupālavigraham
kālīyamardanādau tu nāgakanyādikalpanam
"kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ puṇyaṃ tridaśādhipa'matyapi
yugāntasamaye viṣṇuḥ karkī nāma bhaviṣyati
"karkiṇaṃ kāmarūpaṃ ca viṣṇuṃ saṃhārakāraṇam'
nārāyaṇaṃ prakurvīta ghanaśyāmaṃ caturbhujam
prakuryācca viśeṣeṇa lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ śubham
viṣṇuṃ nīlotpalābhantu śaṅkhāryabjagadābhṛtam
kṛṣṇaṃ tu nīradaśyāmaṃ puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇam
"keśavaṃ kleśasaṃhāraṃ viṣṇuṃ caiva parātparam'
"nārāyaṇaṃ naraṃ viṣṇuṃ narakāntaka' mityapi
"mādhavaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvātmakaṃ' tviti,
"govindaṃ paramānandaṃ viṣṇuṃ caiva sanātanam'

śrī-kānta kṛṣṇa karuṇāmaya kañjanābha
kṛṣṇa rāma mukunda vāmana vāsudeva jagadguro
śrī-nārāyaṇa puṇḍarīka-nayana śrī-rāma sītā-pate
saṃsārārṇava-karṇa-dhāraka hare śrī-kṛṣṇa tubhyaṃ namaḥ
viṣṇu-patni namas tubhyaṃ pāda-sparśaṃ kṣamasva me
nityaṃ pratyālayodyat-praṇaya-bhara-lasat-kṛṣṇa-saṃkīrtanāṭyaṃ
iti mantraṃ paṭhitvā śrī-guruṃ daṇḍavat praśamya evaṃ parama-guru-parātpara-guru-parameṣṭhi-guru-gosvāmi-caraṇān krameṇa daṇḍavat praṇamet
śacī-putrāya mitrāya lakṣmīśāya namo namaḥ
gadādhara namas tubhyaṃ yasya gaurāṅgo jīvanam
namas te śrī-śrīnivāsa-paṇḍita prema-vigraha
jagan-mohana-līlāya namo gopendra-sūnave
patitānāṃ pāvanebhyo vaiṣṇavebhyo namo namaḥ
khād-bhraṣṭā rudra-mūrdhni praṇipatita-jalā gāṃ gatāsīti gaṅgā
mucyate sarva-pāpebhyo viṣṇu-lokaṃ sa gacchati
viṣṇuṃ ca dakṣiṇe kukṣau bāhau ca madhusūdanam
pūrvavat sthirāsane sthira-cittaḥ tatrādau śrī-navadvīpa-madhye śrī-ratna-mandire ratna-siṃhāsanopari bhakta-vṛnda-parisevitaṃ śrī-śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya-devaṃ gurvādi-krameṇa dhyātvā pūjayet
śrī-nārāyaṇa-geham agra-vilasat saṃkīrtana-prāṅgaṇam
svarṇāntaś citra-mantraṃ vasu-hari-caraṇa-dhyāna-gamyāṣṭa-kośam
mantraṃ vakṣyāmi te brahman mahā-puṇya-pradaṃ śubham
ṣaḍakṣaraḥ kīrtito 'yaṃ mantra-rājaḥ sura-drumaḥ
iti nāmāṣṭa-śatakaṃ mantraṃ niveditaṃ śṛṇu
vahni-bījena pūtānte cādau deva namas tathā
ṅe 'ntā vai ṛṣi-varṇo 'yaṃ mantraḥ sarvātidurlabhaḥ
daśārṇa-mantra-rājaś ca sarva-kāryeṣu rakṣitā
prathamaṃ mantra-guroḥ pūjā paścāc caiva mamārcanam
japādau ca guror mantraṃ hy anyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavet
mano-madhye sthito mantro mantra-madhye sthitaṃ manaḥ
mano-mantraṃ samāyuktam etad dhi japa-lakṣaṇam
prathamaṃ gurudevasya mantra-gāyatrīṃ saṃsmaret
śrīlāvadhūtendrādvaita-mantra-gāyatrīṃ saṃsmaret
śrī-guru-parama-gurur ityādi-krameṇa sva-sva-praṇāly-anusāreṇa sva-sva-parivāreśvara-parama-parameṣṭhi-guru-paryantaṃ dhyānaṃ kṛtvā svīya-svīya-nāmāni caturthyantaṃ kṛtvā japānantaraṃ śrī-śrī-caitanya-mahāprabhor mantraṃ gāyatrīṃ ca smaret
anantaraṃ stava-praṇāmādi kṛtvā śrī-gauracandrāṣṭa-kālīya-sūtrānusareṇa smaret--
evaṃ śrī-caitanya-devaṃ niṣevya siddha-dehena śrī-kṛṣṇa-sevāṅgaṃ vidadhyāt
sādhakaḥ siddha-dehena kuryāt kṛṣṇa-priyā-gṛhe
nandīśvara-pure rādhā-kṛṣṇa-kuṇḍa-taṭa-dvaye
nivāso vraja-madhye tu rādhā-kṛṣṇa-sthalī matā
bhāvayan sādhako nityaṃ sthitvā kṛṣṇa-priyā-gṛhe
śrīmad-rādhā-kṛṣṇa-līlā-rasa-pūrita-vigraham
atha śrī-kṛṣṇa-candrasya vayo-veśādayo 'khilāḥ
asyaiva kṛṣṇa-candrasya mantrāḥ santi trayo 'malāḥ
kṛṣṇa tādṛk tathā hare
hare rāma tathā rāma
hare kṛṣṇa hare kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa hare hare
hare rāma hare rāma rāma rāma hare hare
rādhayā sahitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ
devī kṛṣṇa-mayi proktā rādhikā para-devatā
tatra suṣṭhu-kānta-svarūpā, yathā śrī-kṛṣṇa-vākyam
śṛṅgāra-rasa-sarvasvaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ priyatamo mama
vada nārāyaṇa sarva-vittama
ity asyāṃ kṛṣṇa-saukhyārtham eva kevalam udyamaḥ
kṛṣṇa-pārśva-sthitāṃ nityaṃ kṛṣṇa-premaika-vigrahām
vinā rādhā-prasādena kṛṣṇa-prāptir na jāyate
mayūra-piñcha-sadṛśa-vasanā kṛṣṇa-vallabhā

kṛṣṇa prema dena sarva jane
tumi kṛṣṇa svayaṃ prabho jīva uddhārite vibho
kṛṣṇa-tattva
eka-mātra icchāmaya kṛṣṇa sarveśvara
nitya śakti-yoge kṛṣṇa vibhu parātpara
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa-śakti
kṛṣṇa-śakti kṛṣṇa haite nā haya svatantra
yei śakti sei kṛṣṇa kahe veda-mantra
kṛṣṇa vibhu, śakti tāṅra vaibhava svarūpa
ananta vaibhave kṛṣṇa haya eka rūpa
ananta vaikuṇṭha ādi yata kṛṣṇa dhāma
govinda śrī-kṛṣṇa hari ādi yata nāma
ei rūpa kṛṣṇa līlā vicitra gaṇana
cid-vyāpāra samudaya viṣṇu-tattva-sāra
viṣṇu-pada bali vede gāya bāra bāra
kṛṣṇera cid-vibhutā-i viṣṇu-tattva śuddha-tattva
jaḍātīta viṣṇu-tattva śuddha-sattva-sāra
sei saba śuddha-sattva viṣṇu-tattva-sāra
athavā e jaḍe thāke, viṣṇu-nāma dhare
viṣṇu-nāma prāpta vibhu sarva-deva īśa
e samasta viṣṇu-tattva āra viṣṇu-dhāma
kṛṣṇa-pāriṣada mukta-rūpete rahila
sei saba nitya-kṛṣṇa-bahirmukha haila
tathāpi kṛṣṇa-dayā
āmi jīva kṛṣṇa-dāsa, yāya māyā pāre
ye saba asure viṣṇu karena saṃhāra
kṛṣṇa-bahirmukha
karmī jñānī ubhaye-i kṛṣṇa-bahirmukha
kabhu nāhi āsvādaya kṛṣṇa-dāsya-sukha
śraddhāvān haye kṛṣṇa-bhakta-saṅga kare
mukhya pathe jīva pāya kṛṣṇa prema dhana
dhane māne kule śīle kṛṣṇa nāhi mile
nirantara yāra mukhe śuni kṛṣṇa-nāma
kṛṣṇa-nāma āse mukhe kṛṣṇa-bhakti mile
hena kṛṣṇa-nāma jīva ki rūpe karibe
kṛṣṇa-nāma cintāmaṇi anādi cinmaya
yei kṛṣṇa sei nāma eka-tattva haya
kṛṣṇa vastu haya cāri dharme paricita
nitya vastu rasa-rūpa kṛṣṇa se advaya
kṛṣṇa ākarṣaye sarva viśva-gata jana
sei nitya dharma gata kṛṣṇa nāma dhana
kṛṣṇa-rūpa nitya
kṛṣṇa-rūpa kṛṣṇa haite sarvadā abheda
kṛṣṇa-guṇa nitya
kṛṣṇa-guṇa catuḥ-ṣaṣṭhi ananta apāra
yāṅra guṇe nārāyaṇa ṣaṣṭhi guṇeśvara
kṛṣṇa-līlāra nityatva
kṛṣṇa-kṛpā bale krame śuddha bhāva pāya
ei māyika jagate kṛṣṇa-nāma o jīva ei duiṭi mātra cid-vyāpāra
jīva nije cid-vyāpāre kṛṣṇa-nāma āra
mukhya o gauṇa bhede kṛṣṇa-nāma dvi-prakāra
cil-līlā āśraya kari yata kṛṣṇa nāma
govinda gopāla rāma śrī-nanda-nandana
e saba kīrtane jīva pāya kṛṣṇa dhāma
nāmera ye mukhya phala kṛṣṇa prema dhana
eka kṛṣṇa-nāma yadi mukhe bāhirāya
takhana-i śrī-kṛṣṇa-prema labhaye niścaya

mantra-śruti-samanvitam
lakṣmīr abhitaḥ strītamā gopyo lakṣmītamāḥ prathitāḥ
āstāṃ tāvat lakṣmī-vijetṛ-guṇa-gaṇa-gopī-gaṇa-pradhānatayā śrī-kṛṣṇa-sandarbhādau nirṇītā
sāraṃ kṛṣṇa-padārcanam
taṃ vidyād brahma-ghātakam
iti viṣṇu-dharmāgni-purāṇādi-niyamāt
tat sṛṣṭyādi-līlā-gatatve 'pi tad-udāsīneṣv audāsīnyasya yogyatvam
tad-dveṣṭṛṣu tad-dveṣyasyaiveti ca
tathaiva darśitaṃ saptame rājasūyārambhe śrī-yudhiṣṭhirādibhiḥ śiśupālaṃ prati gāli-pradānādinā
ataḥ śrī-bhagavān apy uktaṃ - pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca (Gītā 16.7) ity ārabhya
yat paśyatā 'sakṛt kṛṣṇaṃ tad-darśanam api yoginām
svargāpavarga-viramaḥ svayam āsa viṣṇuḥ
vṛṣṇayaḥ kṛṣṇa-cetasaḥ
atra pratiyugmāntarasthasyāpi śabdasya dvayena yugma-dvayaṃ pṛthag avamyate
tataś ca tad brahmākhya tat taṃ munaya upāsate tad arayo 'pi yayuḥ smaraṇāt
striyaḥ śrī-vraja-devyaḥ aṅghri-saroja-sudhās tat-prema-maya=mādhuryāṇi yayuḥ
vayam api samadṛśas tābhiḥ sama-bhāvāḥ satyaḥ samās tābhiḥ tulyatāṃ prāptāḥ
vyūhāntareṇa gopyo bhūtvā tavāṅghri-saroja-sudhā yayima ity arthaḥ
atra bṛhad-vāmana-purāṇe tāsāṃ prārthanā pūrvakāṇi vākyāni santi
strī-śabdasya gopī vācakatvam
tad arayo 'pi yayuḥ smaraṇād ity anenāsurāṇām api mokṣa-dātṛtvena anyatayā prasiddhasya śrī-kṛṣṇasyaivālambanatvena labdhatvāt
tāsām eva tasmin kevalena rāgeṇa bhajana-prasiddheḥ
tad etad apy āstām śrī-nārāyaṇāṅga-sthitāyā lakṣmīto 'pi tāsāṃ parama-vailakṣaṇyaṃ
tad vidyād ātmano māyāṃ
śriyā puṣṭyā girā kāntyā kīrtyā tuṣṭyelayor jayā ity ādi kiyanto bhedāś ca darśitā
sā ca śakti-dvayī aparā ceti śrī-viṣṇu-purāṇe darśitā
guṇāśrayā namas tasmai
tatra tāvad ekasyaiv svarūpasya sattvāc cittād ānandāc ca svarūpa-bhūtā śaktir apy ekā tridhā
tad uktaṃ viṣṇu-purāṇe
tad uktaṃ śrī-viṣṇu-purāṇe
ete eva viṣṇu-purāṇe lakṣmī-stave spaṣṭīkṛte
athaivambhūtānanta-vṛttikā yā svarūpa-śaktiḥ sā tv iha bhagavad-vāmāṃśa-vartino mūrtimato lakṣmīr evety āha anapāyinī bhagavatī śrīḥ sākṣād ātmano hareḥ
ṭīkā ca - anapāyinī hareḥ śaktiḥ
tatra hetuḥ sākṣād ātmanaḥ sva-svarūpasya cid-rūpatvāt tasyās tad-abhedād ity arthaḥ ity eṣā
viṣṇu-purāṇe
nityaiva sā jagan-mātā viṣṇuḥ śrīr anapāyinī
śrīḥ parā prakṛtiḥ proktā cetanā viṣṇu-saṃśrayā
tataś ca bhagavān kṛṣṇa-saṃjña eva iti nirdhārite na viṣṇunā
vinā devītyādi devatve deva-dehā sā ity ādi tadīya-svarūpa-bhūtā īśa-vāmāṃśa-vartinī lakṣmī kim ākhyā
iti nirdhāryā
tatra dvayor api pūryoḥ śrī-mahiṣyākhyā jñeyā
tadīya-svarūpa-śaktitvaṃ skānda-parbhāsa-khaṇḍe śiva-gaurī-saṃvāde gopyādity-māhātmye dṛṣṭaṃ yathā
lakṣam ekaṃ ṣaṣṭhir ete kṛṣṇa-sutāḥ priye
ity upakramya
haṃsa eva yataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ paramātmā janārdanaḥ
candrarūpī mataḥ kṛṣṇa kalā-rūpāstu tāḥ smṛtāḥ
anuktām antimāṃ mahāśaktim āha sampūrṇeti
seyaṃ tu kalā samaṣṭhirūpā jñeyā
dṛṣṭāntopādānāc candrasya tādṛśatvam āha pratipad iti
āsu etat-tulātve vivakṣitam āha ṣoḍaśaiveti
ṣoḍaśānām eva vidyārūpatvāt
etad-upadeśasya jñāna-sambhava-rahasyatvāt taj-jñānasya vaiṣṇavatvānumāxakaliṅgatvāc ca
krūrām īṣaṇāśokānām api bhagavat-svarūpa-bhūtānām eva satīnāṃ mallānām aśanir ity ādivat śrī-kṛṣṇasya kaṭhinatvaa-pratyāyakatvāt
mṛtur bhojapater itivat durjana-vicitrāsakatvāt
asatāṃ śāstetivat tadīya-śoka-hetutvād evaṃ ca tat-tan-niruktir upapadyate
yathā prakāśaika-rūpāyā eva sūrya-kāntor ulūkeṣu tāmisrādi-vyañjakatā
tataś candra-rūpī mata kṛṣṇaḥ kalā-rūpas tu tāḥ smṛtā iti sphuṭam eva svarūpa-bhūtatvaṃ
darśitam
tad evaṃ tāsāṃ svarūpa-śaktitve lakṣmītvaṃ tāsāṃ siddhaty eva
tad evam abhipretya tāsāṃ lakṣmītvam āha śrī-śukaḥ

oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya
nārāyaṇaṃ namas kṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam
gaṇeśa-śeṣa-brahmeśa-dineśa-pramukhāḥ surāḥ
śrīdaṃ śrīśaṃ śrī-nivāsaṃ śrī-kṛṣṇaṃ rādhikeśvaram
siddhe nārāyaṇa-kṣetre vaṭa-mūle supuṇyade
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ kṛṣṇa-bhaktaṃ ca palaṃ kṛṣṇa-parāyaṇam
śrī-kṛṣṇa-caraṇāmbhoja-dhyānaikatāna-mānasam
japantaṃ paramaṃ brahma kṛṣṇa ity akṣara-dvayam
sukhāsane sukhāsīnaṃ kṛṣṇa-dvaipāyanaṃ munim
atha śrī-kṛṣṇa-bhakti-praśaṃśā
sa pitā jñāna-dātā yo jñānaṃ tat kṛṣṇa-bhaktidam
sā bhaktiḥ paramā śuddhā kṛṣṇa-dāsya-pradā ca yā
sa putraḥ kṛṣṇa-bhakto yo bhārate suyaśas-karaḥ
svayaṃ vidhātā bhagavān paraṃ kṛṣṇa-parāyaṇaḥ
kṛṣṇa-bhakto vasiṣṭas tu tat suto vaiṣṇavaḥ svayam
vaiṣṇavas tat sutaḥ śaktiḥ kṛṣṇa-dhyānaika-mānasaḥ
parāśaraś ca tat-putraḥ kṛṣṇa-pādābja-sevayā
ahaṃ veda-vibhaktā ca śrī-kṛṣṇa-pāda-sevayā
śrī-kṛṣṇa-caraṇāmbhojaṃ pādābjaṃ nāradeśayoḥ
sarasvatīṃ namas kṛtya jñānaṃ vakṣye sanātanam
praṇamya rādhikāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prayayau śiva-mandiram
tato mṛtyuñjayaḥ śambhuḥ saṃprāpa kṛṣṇa-vaktrataḥ
jñānaṃ śuddhaṃ tṛtīyaṃ ca maṅgalaṃ kṛṣṇa-bhaktidam
paripūrṇatamaḥ śrīmān yathā kṛṣṇaḥ sureṣu ca
mantrāṇāṃ kṛṣṇa-mantraś ca yathā vidyā dhaneṣv api
sūkṣmāṇāṃ paramāṇuś ca guruṇāṃ mantra-tantra-daḥ
saubhāgyāsu sundarīṣu rādhā kṛṣṇa-priyāsu ca
śālagrāmaś ca yantrāṇāṃ pūjāsu kṛṣṇa-pūjanam
suśīlaṃ ca guṇānāṃ ca puṇyeṣu kṛṣṇa-kīrtanam
viṣṇu-bhakteṣu vijñeṣu yathaiva nārado muniḥ
siddhe nārāyaṇa-kṣetre sarveṣāṃ abhivāñcchite
svātmārāmaṃ pūrṇa-kāmaṃ jñānināṃ ca guror gurum
kṛṣṇa-mantropāsakasya jīvan-muktasya bhārate
mantra-grahaṇa-mātreṇa puruṣāṇāṃ śataṃ suta
nahi dharmo nahi tapaḥ śrī-kṛṣṇa-sevanāt param
kṛṣṇa-mantropāsakasya tīrtha-pūtasya putraka
mantra-grahaṇa-mātreṇa naṣṭaṃ vahnau yathā tṛṇam
punāti līlayaitāni śuddhaḥ kṛṣṇa-parāyaṇaḥ
nahi pūta-stri-bhuvane śrī-kṛṣṇa-sevakāt paraḥ
śāligrāma-śilā-cakre karoti kṛṣṇa-pūjanam
veda-sāraṃ kṛṣṇa-mataṃ mamāpi nahi kalpanā
sa eva viṣṇu-tulyo hi tad-aṃśo bhārate mune
bhakta-prāṇo hi kṛṣṇaś ca kṛṣṇa-prāṇā hi vaiṣṇavāḥ
dhyāyante vaiṣṇavāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇaś ca vaiṣṇavāṃs tathā
kṛṣṇa-bhakti-vihīnebhyo dvijebhyaḥ śvapaco mahān
brahmaṇānāṃ sva-dharmaś ca santataṃ kṛṣṇa-sevanam
dadhyau kṛṣṇa-padāmbhojaṃ paraṃ kalpa-taruṃ śuka
viṣṇu-bhaktāc ca dharmiṣṭhāt sat-putrāc ca pitā sukhī
śrī-kṛṣṇa-vimukhaṃ mūḍhaṃ dvijam eva narādhamam
tapaḥ karoti śrī-kṛṣṇa-pāda-padmārtham īpsitam
paraṃ śrī-kṛṣṇa-bhajanaṃ dhyānaṃ tan-nāma-kīrtanam
tāmaso hi na jānāti śrī-kṛṣṇaṃ tri-guṇāt param
svapne jñāne na jānāti puṇyaṃ vā kṛṣṇa-pūjanam
kṛṣṇa-bhakta-sahālāpa-darśana-sparśanaṃ śubhaṃ
tad-vastu bhuktaṃ vipreṇa kṛṣṇa-naivedya-miśritam
atha śrī-kṛṣṇa-mahima-varṇanam
na ca taṃ khaṇḍituṃ śaktaḥ svayaṃ viṣṇuś ca śaṅkaraḥ
kaścit kṛṣṇaś ca gauraś ca śyāmalaś ca sva-karmaṇā
kaścid bhaktyā ca prāpnoti kṛṣṇa-dāsyaṃ sudurlabham
bālo voḍhum aśakyantaś ca yayau gamana-mantharaḥ

athavā, saṃmohana-mantra-rūpakaṃ kāma-bījaṃ sakala-gopāla-mantrāṇāṃ bījam udāharati kaleti
kaś ca laś ca kalau tābhyām attau gṛhītau sambaddhau māyā-lavakau caturtha-svarānusvārau tābhyām āttā svīkṛtā bīja-rūpā mūrtir yena saḥ tathoktaḥ kala ity atrākāra uccāraṇārthaḥ
hi yataḥ manūnāṃ gopāla-mantra-vyatiriktānāṃ madhye kaścana mantrorāśyādinā śodhitaḥ kṣiti-sura-prabhṛtīnāṃ varṇānāṃ madhye muni-vanavāsi-prabhṛtīnām āśramāṇāṃ cakārāt strīṇāṃ madhye kasyacit kathaṃcij janasya bhāgya-vaśāj japa-homādibhir ādi-śabdena tarpaṇādeḥ parigrahaḥ
phalati phalaṃ dadātīti yojanā

svāhā-praṇava-saṃyuktaṃ mantraṃ śūdre dadad dvijaḥ
yasmān nūnaṃ niścitam acyuta-kaṭākṣa-pātena śrī-kṛṣṇa-kṛpāvalokane bhaktir añjasā tattvataḥ kāraṇaṃ tatas tasmāt kāraṇāt tac catuṣṭaya-phalāptaye prasiddha-dharmādi-puruṣārtha-catuṣṭaya-rūpa-phala-prāpty-arthaṃ harau viṣṇau gurau mantra-dātari ca bhakti-yukta-puruṣo dīkṣādāv adhikṛto 'dhikārī bhavatīty arthaḥ
etena guru-devatayor abhedena dhyānaṃ kartavyam iti sūcitam
āsīna upaviṣṭaḥ sva-gurūn gaṇeśaṃ ca vandeta
atho śabdaś cārthe 'nukta-samuccayena tenāgre durgāṃ pṛṣṭhe kṣetra-pālaṃ vandeta tad uktaṃ gautamīye vāme guruṃ dakṣiṇato gaṇeśaṃ durgāṃ puraḥ kṣetrapatiṃ ca paścāt
prayogaś ca guṃ gurbhyo namaḥ, gaṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ, duṃ durgāyai namaḥ, kṣeṃ kṣetrapālāya namaḥ
baddhāñjaliḥ kṛtāñjali-puṭaḥ sann ity arthaḥ
atra śāradā-tilakokta-krameṇaitad boddhavyaṃ dakṣiṇe pūjā-dravya-sthāpanaṃ vāme jala-kumbha-sthāpanaṃ pṛṣṭhe kara-prakṣālana-pātra-sthāpanaṃ purato dīpa-cāmarādy-upakaraṇa-sthāpanam iti
iḍā-vaktre vāma-nāsā-puṭe salavakaṃ bindu-sahitaṃ satata-gati-bījaṃ vāyu-bījaṃ yam iti rūpaṃ pūrvaṃ prathamaṃ mantrī sādhakaḥ smaret
kim bhūtam ? dhūmraṃ kṛṣṇa-varṇaṃ
punaḥ kimbhūtam ? sakaleti
pañca-bhūta-maya-deha-śoṣakaṃ tathā ca vāma-nāsā-puṭena vāyum ākarṣan ṣoḍaś-vāraṃ vāyu-bījaṃ japed iti bhāvaḥ
anantaraṃ sakalaṃ sarvaṃ svakīyaṃ śarīraṃ tena bīja-mayena vāyunā pratata-vapuṣā vistīrṇa-śarīreṇāpūrya pūrayitvā deha-stha-vāyor bāhyenaikyaṃ vicintya viśoṣaṃ nītvā catuḥ-ṣaṣṭhi-vāraṃ vāyu-bījaṃ kumbhakena japtvā khamaṇeḥ sūryasya mārgeṇa piṅgalayā dakṣiṇa-nāsā-puṭena recanenaiva vāyu-bījaṃ dvātriṃśad-vāraṃ japan vāyuṃ vyāmuñcet tyajed ity arthaḥ
keśava-kīrtī nārāyaṇa-kāntī
govindaḥ puṣṭi-yuto viṣṇu-dhṛtī sūdanaś ca madhvādyaḥ
nara-ṛddhī naraka-jitāsamṛddhir atha śuddhi-yug ghariḥ kṛṣṇaḥ
sahitāvasthitayor evopasthitau caturthy-arthānvaya-sambhavāt varnānvaya-sambhavāc ca agnīṣomayor iva sahitāvasthitayor devatātvam
kathaṃ tarhi yādiṣu tvag-ādi-prayogaḥ kāryam ? ity ucyate yaṃ tvag-ātmane puruṣottama-vasudhābhyām namaḥ, raṃ asṛg-ātmane bali-parābhyāṃ nama ity evaṃ rūpa iti
mantram uktāvali-kāreṇa tathaivābhidhānāt
ātmane ity asya sub-anta-pratirūpaka-nipātatvenādoṣād iti tu prapañca-sāra-vivaraṇe paramānanda-bhaṭṭācāryābhyāḥ
tathā ca aṃ keśava-kīrtibhyāṃ nama iti prayogaḥ mantram uktāvalī-kāra-laghu-dīpikā-kāra-tripāṭhi-rudropādhyāya-vidyādharācārya-paramānanda-bhaṭṭācārya-saṃmataḥ
aṃ keśavāya kīrtyai nama iti prayogaḥ padmapādācārya-prabhṛtīnāṃ saṃmata iti
jñātvā yathā-guru-sampradāyaṃ
viṣṇuṃ vande dara-kamala-kaumodakī-cakra-pāṇim
ahaṃ viṣṇuṃ vande
kīdṛśaṃ ? udyann udayaṃ gacchan pradyotanaḥ sūryas tasya yac-chataṃ tasyeva ruci-dīptir yasya taṃ punaḥ tapteti vahni-madhya-nikṣipta-kāñcanavad gauraṃ
punaḥ kīdṛśaṃ pārśva-dvandve iti dakṣiṇa-vāma-pārśva-dvaye jaladhi-sutayā lakṣmyā tathā viśva-dhātryā pṛthivyā juṣṭaṃ sevitam
punaḥ kimbhūtaṃ ? nānā-vidha-ratnena śobhito nānā bahu-prakāra ākalpo bhūṣaṇaṃ yasya
punaḥ kīdṛśaṃ ? āpīteti āsamyak prakāreṇa pīte vastre yasya taṃ
punaḥ kīdṛśaṃ ? daraḥ śaṅkhaḥ padmaṃ kamalaṃ kaumodakī gadā cakram etāni pāṇau yasya tam
atra ūrdhvādhaḥ krameṇa vāma-bhāge śaṅkha-padme dakṣiṇa-bhāge gadā-cakre iti bodhyam
evam ukta-prakāraṃ parama-pumāṃsaṃ viṣṇuṃ dhyātvā yo 'nudinaṃ pratyahaṃ keśavādi-sahitair mātṛkākāair vinyasyet sa puruṣaḥ
medhādibhiś ciraṃ bahu-kālam upabṛṃhita upacito bhavati medhā dhāraṇāvatī buddhiḥ āyur jīvanaṃ smṛtiḥ smaraṇaṃ dhṛtir dhairyaṃ kīrtir utkṛṣṭa-karma-kathā kāntiḥ saundaryaṃ lakṣmīr aiśvaryaṃ saubhāgyaṃ sarva-priyatvam
iti pūrvokta-prakāreṇa acyutīkṛta-tanuḥ sampādita-viṣṇu-śarīraḥ tattva-
sakala-vapuṣi sarvāṅga-vyāpake jīvaṃ prāṇaṃ ca mantre āyojya tena nyasyatu tathā ca maṃ namaḥ parāya jīvātmane namaḥ bhaṃ namaḥ parāya prāṇātmane namaḥ iti dvayaṃ sarva-śarīre vinyasyed ity arthaḥ
iti tattva-padaṃ dattvā maṃ namaḥ parāya jīva-tattvātmane namaḥ iti kecit tat-prayogān kurvanti tan na pramāṇābhāvāt mūrti-pañjara-nyāse 'pi mūrti-pada-prayogāpatteḥ
atra makarādīnāṃ bindu-sāhityaṃ sampradāyāvagataṃ boddhavyam
madhye hṛdaye matim ahaṅkāraṃ manaś ca mantra āyojya tena mantrī nyasyatu tathā baṃ namaḥ parāya mana ātmane namaḥ phaṃ namaḥ parāya ahaṅkārātmane namaḥ paṃ namaḥ parāya mana ātmane namaḥ iti trayaṃ hṛdi vinyasyed ity arthaḥ
atho 'nantaraṃ kamukha-hṛdaya-guhyāṅghriṣu pañcasu
nārāyaṇaś ca kramaśah parameṣṭhyādibhir yutaḥ
tatas tad-anantaraṃ krameṇa gurūpadeśa-krameṇa taj-jñaḥ nṛsiṃha-bīja-jñaḥ kṣarau kṣa-kāra-repha-au-kāra iti milita-svarūpaṃ bindu-yuktaṃ tathā kopa-tattvaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ ca mantre āyojya sarva-gātreṣu nyasyet
tathā ca-kṣrauṃ namaḥ parāya nṛsiṃhāya kopātmane namaḥ iti sarva-gātreṣu nyasyed ity arthaḥ
tattva-nyāsam upasaṃharati ity ukta-prakāreṇa tattvātmako nyāsaḥ kathito bhavati
kīdṛśaḥ ? viśva-mūrty-ādiṣu sva-sānnidhya-kṛt kṛṣṇa-sānnidhya-kṛt bimbādiṣv iti kecid bimbaṃ pratimā mūrtiḥ śarīram ādi-padena maṇi-mantrādi-sakalasya parigrahaḥ eteṣu hareḥ sānnidhyaṃ karotīty arthaḥ
kvacin martyādiṣv iti pāṭhaḥ

īśvaraḥ paramaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sac-cid-ānanda-vigrahaḥ
dvāravatyāṃ yathā kṛṣṇaḥ pratyakṣaṃ pratimandiram
kvacic caturbhujatve'pi na tyajet kṛṣṇa-rūpatām
tatra puruṣa-lakṣaṇaṃ, yathā śrī-viṣṇu-purāṇe
avāpa nārāyaṇa ādidevaḥ
nārāyaṇaḥ sa bhagavān āpas tasmāt sanātanāt
viṣṇur brahmā ca rudraś ca sthiti-sargādi-karmaṇe
rudra ekādaśa-vyūhas tathāṣṭatanur apy asau
kālāgni-rudraḥ kalpānte bhavet saṅkarṣaṇād api
śrī-viṣṇuḥ, yathā śrī-tṛtīye
tal loka-padmaṃ sa u eva viṣṇuḥ
yo viṣṇuḥ paṭhyate so'sau kṣīrāmbudhiśayo mataḥ
viṣṇu-dharmottarādy-uktā yāḥ pūryo'jāṇḍa-madhyataḥ
santi viṣṇu-prakāśānāṃ tāḥ kathyante samāsataḥ
agamyaḥ sarva-lokānāṃ viṣṇu-lokaḥ prakīrtitaḥ
kiṃ ca viṣṇu-purāṇādau mokṣa-dharme ca kīrtitam
viṣṇuḥ sattvaṃ tanotīti śāstre sattva-tanuṃ smṛtaḥ
siddhānte punar eka eva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ samastāgama-
nārāyaṇa-kalāḥ śāntā bhajanti hy anasūyavaḥ
viṣṇu-dharmottare tv etat mārkaṇḍeyena bhāṣitam
matsya-rūpa-dharo viṣṇuḥ śṛṅgī bhūtvā jagat-patiḥ
viṣṇu-dharmottarāj jñeyāḥ prādurbhāvāś caturdaśa
varaṃ dattvānasūyāyai viṣṇuḥ sarva-jaganmayaḥ
ato viṣṇu-purāṇādau viśeṣeṇaiva varṇitaḥ
kṛṣṇa-dvaipāyanaṃ vyāsaṃ viddhi nārāyaṇaṃ svayam
atha śrī-rāma-kṛṣṇau
śrī-prathame
rāma-kṛṣṇāv iti bhuvo bhagavān aharad bharam
śrī-rāmaḥ
saṅkarṣaṇo dvitīyo yo vyūhaḥ rāmaḥ sa eva hi
śrī-kṛṣṇaḥ
janitā viṣṇu-yaśaso nāmnā kalkir jagat-patiḥ
bhāvī viṣṇu-yaśās cāyam iti pādme prakīrtitam
dvādaśe rudra-sāvarṇanīye sudhāmā
tathā hi śrī-viṣṇu-dharmottare śrī-rudra-praśnaḥ
yavīyāṃsam ahaṃ premnā kṛṣṇaṃ praśyāmi nārada
dvāparānte karma-bhūtau āyātau kṛṣṇa-phālgunau
nṛsiṃha-rāma-kṛṣṇeṣu ṣāḍguṇyaṃ paripūritam
vāgīśā yasya vadane lakṣmīr yasya ca vakṣasi
viṣṇu-dharmottare rāma-lakṣmaṇādyāḥ kramādamī
pādme tu rāmo bhagavān nārāyaṇa itīritaḥ
bilvamaṅgale
hiraṇyakaśipor asmin viṣṇu-buddhir na niścitā
tena niścitya taṃ viṣṇuṃ svasya dvir-maraṇaṃ yataḥ
upendra iti kṛṣṇa tvāṃ gāsyanti divi devatāḥ
śrī-viṣṇu-purāṇe
māṃ kṛṣṇa-rūpiṇaṃ yāvan nāpnuvanti mama dviṣaḥ
pūjyante'syāvṛtitvena rāma-siṃhānanādayaḥ
svakṛta-kuśalākuśalaṃ phalam upādadāti
aho svid ātmārāma upaśama-śīlaḥ
ato yo narabhū-nīrāyaṇān nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ
kiṃ vidhātrā sa hi sita-kṛṣṇa-keśatayoditaḥ
kleśa-vyayāya kalayā sita-kṛṣṇa-keśaḥ
taṃ śrī-kṛṣṇaṃ vijānāmi prapitāmaham eva te
catvāro vāsudevādyā nārāyaṇa-nṛsiṃhakau
māhātmyaṃ kṛṣṇa-candrasya viriñcena samarthitam
vidyāyāḥ pañca-parvāṇi sāṅkhyādīny atra pañca ca

provenance.rawSnippet:
ādhāraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ yena viṣṇuḥ prasāditaḥ.
MKm MKm MKm MKm MKm
praṇāmaṃ ye 'pi kurvanti teṣām api namo namaḥ.
prāpa yajñapatiṃ viṣṇuṃ tam ārādhaya suvrata.
ye smaranti sadā viṣṇuṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam
na kaścit smarate devaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kalimalāpaham.
ye smaranti sadā viṣṇuṃ viśuddhenāntarātmanā
te bhinnadehāḥ praviśanti viṣṇuṃ havir yathā mantrahutaṃ hutāśe.
ye mānavā vigatarāgaparāvarajñā nārāyaṇaṃ suraguruṃ satataṃ smaranti
idam ekaṃ suniṣpannaṃ dhyeyo nārāyaṇaḥ sadā.
ārādhayaiva naro viṣṇuṃ manaso yad yad icchati
nānyo dharttā jagannāthaṃ muktvā nārāyaṇaṃ param.
tāvac cet smarate viṣṇuṃ ko na mucyeta bandhanāt.
bhaktyā sampūjito viṣṇuḥ phalaṃ datte samīhitam.
karāvalambanaṃ dehi śrī kṛṣṇa kamalekṣaṇa
kīrtayanti suraśreṣṭhaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum.
sarvabhūteṣu kurute tasya viṣṇuḥ prasīdati.
yo jāto nārcayed viṣṇuṃ na smaren nāpi kīrtayet.

jagan-mohana-līlāya namo gopendra-sūnave
ekadā kiñcin-mātra-śruta-pūrva-vṛttāntayā satyabhāmayā kṛṣṇaḥ sākūtaṃ pṛṣṭaḥ
tatas tad-vṛttānta-smaraṇāt kṛṣṇaḥ svāntar-glānir bahir vihasyāha
kṛṣṇaḥ punar āha
ekadā kārttike māsi gokule govardhana-girau
tato lalitā sarvāsāṃ mauktikāni punaḥ punaś cālayantī bhūyaḥ prāha
he kṛṣṇa!
śrī-bhagavatī-pāda-padma-siddha-mantra-śiṣyā-nāndīmukhī-sakāśāt
sakhyaḥ
satyaṃ mukundasya na mantra-kṛteyaṃ mṛdi mauktikā sṛṣṭiḥ
kim atra yuktam iti mantrayitum ārebhire
aye gṛhīta-kṛṣṇa-pakṣayā
tasmād etan-mantraṇam atīvānucitam
subala-bhāṣitam eva kiñcid bhāti
tathāpi
kṛṣṇaḥ - priye! anurādheti lalitāyā evāpara-paryāyaḥ
kṛṣṇaḥ - tato'haṃ smita-śavalita-campakalatā-vadana-candram ālokayaṃs tad
vidyādhara-rājo mayā vyadhāyi
girīndra-rājo govardhanaś ca saptāham
viśākhā -- viṣṇu viṣṇu tad-vṛtti-darśanaṃ tāvad-dūre'stu sa eva kadāpi na
sura-nara-gaṇa-gandharva-vidyādhara-muni-vara-vandita-bhuvaneśvarī-śata-vand
gurutvenāsādyāsyāḥ sakāśāt mahādevī-mantra-rājaṃ didīkṣiṣur ahaṃ tvāṃ
sampādya sva-vidyāyāḥ prabhāvam asau darśayatu
tato viśrabhya
vinyasya ṣaḍ-akṣara-mantra-rājasyāsya svayambhū-ṛṣi-gāyatrī chandaḥ
mantra-rājam upadiśya māṃ kṛtārthīkarotu
kṛṣṇa-nāma-yaśaḥ-śrāva-vataṃsollāsi-karṇikām
evainaṃ dīkṣaya
tadāsya siddhāto mantra-grahaṇāt svābhīṣṭa-kāma-lābho jhaṭiti
kṛṣṇaḥ -- priye! etad gokula-vilāsānanda-niṣkuṭe viharamāṇasya mama tvat-praśna
kṛṣṇaḥ -- tataḥ subalaḥ sasmitam āha -- priyavayasya! priya-sakhīyam indulekhā
mṛga-lāñchana-rahitāyā etasyā hṛn-madhye mañjula-kṛṣṇa-sāro'haṃ bhavāmīti
prasādīkṛta-sva-sarvasva-svarūpa-vilāsa-ratnāni mantra-gurau mayi dakṣiṇātvena
kṛṣṇaḥ -- tadānīm eva mallī-bhṛṅgībhyām ānīya dattaṃ lekha-dvayam
sarvābhiḥ
ṭeṣu kinnarī-gandharvī-kuleṣu sānandaṃ gāyatsu
apsaro-vidyādharī-vargeṣu
kṛṣṇa rādhe kṛṣṇeti kīrtanāmṛtena sandhukṣitā kṣaṇaṃ maunena dhairyam
gandharva-vidyādhara-gaṇa-gīyamāna-mahā-vaibhavāyāḥ ātmabhuvāpi
sarva-kālīna-nija-vāsa-grāma-mahāvanam apahāya vatsara-ṣaṭ-saptaka-mātram
caraṇa-paricaraṇa-mātraika-lābhāya tan-mantra-rājam ādātum
kṛṣṇa-vanatvena prathita-khyātyā vṛndāvana-rāja-dhānī-purandaratvena
kṛṣṇa-vana-śabdasyārthāntaraṃ nūnam eṣā ghaṭayiṣyatīti tad-abhiprāyaṃ manasi
pradarśya mat-priya-sakhyāḥ khelāspada-kṛṣṇa-vanam idam ādātuṃ
evāpasariṣyasi
[samāsābhijña kṛṣṇa-vana-śabdasya narma-cchalena
rādhā anuccaiḥ - vanasyāsya ghanatā-prācaryeṇa kṛṣṇaṃ śyāmaṃ ca tad-vanaṃ ceti
vanāni yatra tat kṛṣṇa-vanam iti vṛndāvanasya viśeṣaṇatvena bahuvrīhir api
mayoktaṃ - jaḍa-buddhike! kṛṣṇasya vanaṃ kṛṣṇa-vanam iti ṣaṣṭhī-tatpuruṣas
kṛṣṇaḥ - priye! vijñāpaya
kṛṣṇaḥ - priye! rādhāyāḥ kāya-vyūha-rūpā eva lalitādayas tat kathaṃ
kṛṣṇaḥ - priye śrūyatām
kṛṣṇaḥ - tato'haṃ - nāndīmukhi! lalitādīnāṃ tāruṇya-dhanād api tasyās
deyāni
kintv iyaṃ mantra-vidāṃ mūrdhanyā tataḥ śvaḥ paraśvo vā parama-śuciḥ
kāntadarpābhidhācārya-nirukta-mantra-paṭalaṃ mahyam upadiśatu
yatheha
tan-mantra-caturā kāñcana-latair ācāryā kriyatāṃ bhavatā
satyā - gokula-vilāsārāma-matta-kokila! tatas tataḥ ?
kṛṣṇaḥ - priye! śrutaṃ śrotavyam

sarvalokeśvaro viṣṇuḥ sṛṣṭyādyaṣṭakṛdīśvaraḥ
muktābhuktodaro viṣṇuḥ anantānantabhānuruk
chāyeva sūkṣmasthūloru rūpaṃ viṣṇuṃ samāśritā
nīleṣvayogyajīveṣu nīlā durgābhimāninī
laye lakṣmīvaśāḥ sṛṣṭau brahmādyairabhimānibhiḥ
nityān savyañjayan teṣāṃ sṛṣṭau durgāmupādiśat
keśavādyāścaturviṃśat gāyatrīvarṇadevatāḥ
viṣṇumantrodito viṣṇuḥ sarvātmā parikīrtitaḥ
vibhinno viśvato viṣṇuḥ deśato guṇato vibhuḥ
gamyaṃ satyaṃ ca sukhacinmayaṃ viṣṇuṃ sanātanam
nikṣipya ca nigīryeśomāyāyāṃ mahadāhvayam
śrībhūdurgāpatirviśvataijasaprājñanāmakāḥ
tato viṣṇuḥ satvabindugataḥ saṃvardhayatyajaḥ
śrībhūdurgāsvādyamādya tṛtīyāvaraṇeṣu hi
vidyādibhistribhistāsu gāyatryādiṣu tisṛṣu
vidyādyutthairbrahmapūrvaistribhiḥ rudrastrirūpakaḥ
lakṣmīnārāyaṇo brahmavāyū bhāryāsamanvitau
vijñānanāmako viṣṇuḥ ahaṅkārasya rakṣakaḥ
lakṣmīnārāyaṇau vyāptau maryādā na tayoḥ kvacit
rajastamoṇavo rudraśakrādisurasūkṣmagāḥ
brahmāsarasvatīviṣṇoḥ sarvāṅgaiḥ sambhavanti hi
bhūdurgābhāgayoḥ prāptavyānanda(daṃ śuddha) sātvikaiḥ
bhūdurgābhyāṃ kalpitaistairbhagavān bhaktasantateḥ
tādṛjjotistāvadantaṃ viṣṇuṃ paśyati cakṣuṣā
bhavanti nityadā viṣṇuḥ sureṣvantarhito hi saḥ
sa viṣṇuḥ padmanābhākhyo bhūdaṇḍasalile śubhe
hanumatpūjito rāmaḥ nāthaḥ kiṃpuruṣasya tu
vasatyasya mahārudraḥ sāṃbaścāṣṭatanuḥ svayam
aranāmnīṇyanāmnī sā bhūdurgābhāgayordvayoḥ
sukumārābhidhaṃ rudraśāpāttatragataḥ pumān
candrāntaryāmiṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ śālmalasthā bhajanti hi
varuṇāntargataṃ viṣṇuṃ bhajanti hi tatotra hi
nārāyaṇa viśeṣāveśaidhitātmagatiḥ svayam
dhruvādīn grahān viṣṇuḥ cakre sarvān suvāruṇaiḥ
lakṣmīnārāyaṇau śuddhacidrūpau vyāptavigrahau
durgābhāgastadupari bhūbhāgastu tadūrdhvataḥ
śvetadvīpodvyaṣṭalakṣa durgābhāgastu tanmitaḥ
durgābhūḥśrīsvabhāgeṣu anantānantarūpiṇī
anantarūpiṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ sadārādhayatīśvaram
dehairmodanti bhūdurgābhāgayoḥ śrīśalālitāḥ
śrībhūdurgābhāga ete sevante harimañjasā
durgābhāgasthāniruddhātsūkṣmayuktā bhavanti hi
tapaḥ satyeṣu durgākhyabhāge nīcoccakāḥ kramāt
nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ tāpasomanurīritaḥ
durgābhāgastvadhodeśaḥ bhūkando daśalakṣakaḥ
evaṃ durgābhāgagato paryāvaraṇasaṅgatā
nadyau durgābhūmayāmbusamite śrīharipriye
śrīdurgābhyāṃ ca bhūmyā ca ekībhūte vilakṣake
ete muktāstu bhūbhāge durgābhāge tathaiva ca
nandinī haripādotthā durgābhāgaśubhodakā
bhāvarūpājñānamāninyapi durgājagadguroḥ
aviditvānyathābrūyuḥ durgājñānapradaiva sā

omādyamasmacchabdaṃ tu pitṛbhyastadanantaram
agnīṣomāśrayasthasya pūrvaṃ pitṛgaṇasya ca
prāgvat svadhāvasānāghairmantrair oṃkārapūrvakaiḥ
oṃ namo vaḥ pitaro namo vāḥ (? vai )puruṣottama
namo viṣṇupadasthebhyaḥ svadhā vaḥ pitaro namaḥ
haraye pitṛnāthāya hyagnīṣomātmane namaḥ
satsomapātmane viṣṇo namo barhiṣadātmane
tubhyaṃ namo bhagavate pitṛmūrte 'nyutāya ca
namo 'ntaṃ praṇavādyaṃ tu marudambaravigraham
sadvādaśākṣaro mantraḥ kavacaṃ brahmaṇe namaḥ
yoktavyaṃ tatra ca aṅgānāṃ mantraṣaṭkaṃ yathā sthitam
agnīṣomākhyadaivatyaṃ rakṣārthaṃ sarvadaiva hi
svāhāmadhyoditaṃ kṛtvā pūjāsāre ? tathā nale
agnīṣomāśrayasthaṃ ca citpiṇḍaṃ tattu vai kramāt
yat pitryadaivataṃ mantraṃ brahmarandhropari sthitam
bhagavadbhaktipūtā ( tmā ? )tanmantraika ( ?mantra ) parāyaṇaḥ
abhyarthāsanakarmākhyaṃ mantraṃ yadavatāritam
uttāraṇārthamapi vai yajāmyomoṃ namo nāmaḥ
tejaḥsvabhāvamamalaṃ bhogaṃ bhuṅkṣvoṃ namo namaḥ
oṃ namo 'smaptitṛgaṇāt prīto bhava jaganmaya
punarardhyodakaṃ pāṇau datvā mantraṃ samuccaran
saṃsmaran manasā mantraṃ pratipadya dvijāmbhasā
tatra divye purā mantraṃ pūrvavat saṃprapūjya ca
vyaktaye manasaścaiva kavacaṃ vihitaṃ dvija
bhūtānām astrāmantraṃ tu vāditāṃ ? santataṃ hi nam
ṣaṇṇām atha śikhāmantraṃ svā dyakhātapa (?khādyasvānta ) (?pra )vinyaset
mantraśakticchalenaiva sānnena praṇavātmanā
svāhāntānāṃ tatasteṣāṃ tatra sthānaṃ samācaret
japed ekatamaṃ mantraṃ dīkṣitasvekameva hi
tato viśeṣabhogānāṃ prabhorāmantraṇāya ca
nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ brahma prāṇeśa caturākṛte
viṣṇu pāṣadabhedeṣu janmakarmarateṣu ca
praṇavālaṃkṛtaṃ mantraṃ tamudyatakaraḥ paṭhet
rakṣa māṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa kṣamasvāja prasīda om
kalaśadvitayaṃ mantraṃ rakṣāsaubhāgyamokṣadam
svabījaṃ mantravarṇaṃ tu oṃ lakṣmīpataye namaḥ
maṇḍūkāmbujasaṃsthāṃ ca dakṣiṇe tu sarasvatīm
kuryād vinyastadehaṃ tu dhyātvā mantraṃ karodare
ekādeśe 'hni vidyārthī vidyānāthamaheśvaram
proccarenmanasā mantraṃ mantradhyānaṃ tu gopayet
mantra - mudrāsana - dhyānair devatānāṃ yadarcanam
na yānti paramāṃ siddhiṃ vinā mantra piragrahāt
abhyarthanādinā mantraṃ yatkramāt samupāgatam
cittaprasāda janako mantraḥ saṃsāraduḥkhahṛt
bimbasaṃruddha - mantraṃ ca tadvimuktamapi dvija
anugrahaparaṃ mantraṃ śabdabrahmamayaṃ svakam
hṛdayāvarjako yatra viśrāmaḥ paramārthataḥ
tad eva kavacaṃ viddhi mantrāṇāṃ hi balātmakam
yatsarvajñasya śaktervai vidyāvidyātmakaṃ vapuḥ
tamasastapano viṣṇuḥ satva (?tve ) dhibhūtatā
darśayitvopasaṃhṛtya mantraṃ hṛtkamalodare
pratiṣṭhitaṃ nitya mantraṃ vinā sthala jalātmakān
aparaḥ sīrapāṇir vai rāmaḥ kṛṣṇātmanā saha
dharmātmā bhagavān viṣṇuḥ prādurbhāvaṃ ca śāśvatam
samastasaubhāgyanidhir lakṣmīnāthaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ
lakṣmīrūpāntarair yuktaḥ caturbhir garūḍāsanaḥ
vidyāmūrtiścaturvaktro brahmā vai lokapūjitaḥ
agnīṣomātmasaṃjñasya devasya paramātmanaḥ
kartavyatvena ye viṣṇuṃ saṃyajanti phalaṃ vinā
saṃsthitaścāparo rāmaḥ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇaḥ

viśrāma-mandiratyā tasya sanātana-tanor mad-īśasya
bhakta-makarān aśīlita-mukti-nadīkān namasāmi
krameṇaiva pralīyeta viṣṇu-bhakti-ratātmanām
kṛtānuyātrā-vidyābhir hari-bhaktir anuttamā
śrī kṛṣṇa-caraṇāmbhoja-sevā-nirvṛta-cetasām
nārāyaṇa-parāḥ sarve na kutaścana bibhyati
hayaśīrṣīya-śrī-nārāyaṇa-vyūha-stave ca--
muktānām api siddhānāṃ nārāyaṇa-parāyaṇaḥ
siddhāntatas tv abhede 'pi śrīśa-kṛṣṇa-svarūpayoḥ
rasenotkṛṣyate kṛṣṇa-rūpam eṣā rasa-sthitiḥ
guru-pādāśrayas tasmāt kṛṣṇa-dīkṣādi-śikṣaṇam
kṛṣṇa-tad-bhakta-vidveṣa-vinindādy-asahiṣṇutā
- śrī-kṛṣṇa-dīkṣādi-śikṣaṇaṃ, yathā tatraiva
viṣṇu-loka-sthitā sampad-alolā sā pratīkṣate
- atha śrī-kṛṣṇa-vimukha-jana-saṃtyāgo, yathā kātyāyana-saṃhitāyām--
viṣṇu-rahasye ca--
kṛṣṇa-nāmākṣarair gātram aṅkayec candanādinā
kṛṣṇa-praṇāmī na punar-bhavāya
viṣṇuṃ pradakṣinī-kurvan yas tatrāvartate punaḥ
hareḥ sālokyam āpnoti rudra-gānādhikaṃ bhavet
tatra nāma-kīrtanam, yathā viṣṇu-dharme--
kṛṣṇāya nama ity eṣa mantraḥ sarvārtha-sādhakaḥ
śrī-kṛṣṇa-stava-ratnaughair yeṣāṃ jihvā tv alaṅkṛtā
sarva-pāpa-vinirmukto viṣṇu-lokam avāpnuyāt
- atha śrī-mūrteḥ sparśanaṃ, yathā viṣṇu-dharmottare--
kṛṣṇeti vaiṣṇavaṃ mantraṃ śrutvā mukto bhaven naraḥ
hṛd-vāg-vapurbhir vidadhan namas te
yathā viṣṇu-purāṇe
sadyo naśyati pāpaugho namas tasmai cid-ātmane
dhanyās te mānavā loke tesāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ prasīdati
nāma cintāmaṇiḥ kṛṣṇaś caitanya-rasa-vigrahaḥ
ataḥ śrī-kṛṣṇa-nāmādi na bhaved grāhyaṃ indriyaiḥ
kṛṣṇa-bhakto yathā--
nirbandhaḥ kṛṣṇa-sambandhe yuktaṃ vairāgyam ucyate
sa vai manaḥ kṛṣṇa-padāravindayor
yad asyāṃ kṛṣṇa-saukhyārtham eva kevalam udyamaḥ
kṛṣṇaṃ smaran janaṃ cāsya preṣṭhaṃ nija-samīhitam
dṛṣṭvā rāmaṃ hariṃ tatra bhoktum aicchan suvigraham
ataeva nārāyaṇa-vyūha-stave--
ye dhyāyanti sadodyuktās tebhyo 'pīha namo namaḥ
kṛṣṇa-tad-bhakta-kāruṇya-mātra-lābhaika-hetukā
sādhanābhiniveśena kṛṣṇa-tad-bhaktayos tathā
tatrānvahaṃ kṛṣṇa-kathāḥ pragāyatām
atha śri-kṛṣṇa-tad-bhakta-prasādajaḥ
sa bhāvaḥ kṛṣṇa-tad-bhakta-prasādaja itīyate
atha śrī-kṛṣṇa-prasādajaḥ--
adṛṣṭa-pūrvam ālokya kṛṣṇaṃ jāṅgala-vāsinaḥ
vinopāyair upeyābhūd viṣṇu-bhaktir ihoditā
daśatv alaṃ gāyata viṣṇu-gāthāḥ
atha kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛte
tad-guṇākhyāne āsāktiḥ, yathā kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛte
bhāvo 'py abhāvam āyāti kṛṣṇa-preṣṭhāparādhataḥ
yaḥ prathīyān bhaved bhāvaḥ sa tu kṛṣṇa-prasādajaḥ
śrī-kṛṣṇa-gāthāṃ gāyantī romāṇcodbheda-lakṣaṇā
asmin-manvantare snigdhā śrī-kṛṣṇa-priya-vartayā
abhisandhi-vinirmuktā bhaktir-viṣṇu-vaśaṅkarī
eṣā kṛṣṇa-ratiḥ sthāyī bhāvo bhakti-raso bhavet

mantra-mayyāṃ samāsena sevā kiñcid vilikhyate
sva-sevā samarpitā
tatrāpi śrī-paṇḍita-gosvāmi-śiṣyaḥ premi-kṛṣṇa-dāsa-
śrīla-sanātana-gosvāminā svasyātīvāntaraṅgāya śrī-kṛṣṇa-dāsa-brahmacāriṇe
kila śrī-hari-dāsa-gosvāmi-śrī-kṛṣṇa-dāsa-brahmacāri-gosvāmi-śrī-madhu-
ataeva mauna-mudrādikaṃ prakāśya vigrahaval-līlā-kāle sarveṣāṃ śrī-kṛṣṇa-
prakāśānāṃ tatraivānyatra sthitaḥ san śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya-mahāprabhos tat
śrīmad-vṛndāvanendraḥ prabhavatu bhavatāṃ bhūtaye kṛṣṇa-candraḥ
tathā hi śrī-kṛṣṇa-sandarbhe śrī-bhāgavata-ṣaṣṭha-skandhe -māṃ keśvavo
nau sarvatra deśe yathā śrī-kṛṣṇa-prakāśādīnāṃ navīna-prācīnā-dhātu-śīlādy-
gopālāya govardhanāya gopī-jana-vallabhāya namo namaḥ
īśvaraḥ paramaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ saccidānanda-vigrahaḥ
kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ samabhavat paramaḥ pumān yo
akarot, sa devaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ samabhavan taṃ bhajāmīti
kṛṣṇāya gopīnāthāya govindāya namo namaṃ
namaḥ praṇata-pālāya śrī-kṛṣṇāya namo namaḥ
advitīyāya mahate śrī-kṛṣṇāya namo namaḥ
keśava kleśa-haraṇa nārāyaṇa janārdana
śrī-govinda-sthalākhyaṃ taṭam idam amalaṃ kṛṣṇa-saṃyoga-pīṭhaṃ
śrīmad-govinda-mantra-stha-ballavī-vṛnda-sevitam
divya-vraja-vayo-rūpaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vṛndāvaneśvaram
paramaṃ kāraṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ govindākhyaṃ parātparam
pratyaṅga-rabhasāveśāḥ pradhānāḥ kṛṣṇa-vallabhāḥ
prakṛty aṣṭau tad anyāś ca pradhānāḥ kṛṣṇa-vallabhāḥ
ṣoḍaśī prakṛti-śreṣṭhā pradhānā kṛṣṇa-vallabhā
kiṃ ca śrī-kṛṣṇa-sandarbhe
tad evaṃ tatra śrī-kṛṣṇa-līlā dvividhā aprakaṭa-rūpā prakaṭa-rūpā ca
ekatara-sthānādi-niyata-sthitikā tat-tan-mantra-dhyāna-mayī
yathā bṛhad-dhyāna-
pītāmbara-dharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ puṇḍarīka-nibhekṣaṇam
ity ādi gautamīya-tantre
cintayaṃś cetasā kṛṣṇaṃ mukto bhavati saṃsṛteḥ
tatra ca-kārāt śrī-gopendrādayo gṛhyante
rāma-śabdena rohiṇy api
tathā tenaiva
prakaraṇa eva etau paṭhitau
tataś ca nārāyaṇa-varmākhya-mantropāsya-
rādhikā (śrī-kṛṣṇa-mukhendum avalokya): hanta ! hanta ! ṇibbha-rūkkaṇḍidā e
dakṣiṇasyāṃ sthitā śyāmā kṛṣṇa-keli-vinodinī
govindāya tataḥ paścāt svāhāyaṃ dvādaśākṣaraḥ
govindasya mahā-mantraḥ kāle pūrvānurāga-bhāk
evaṃ dhyātvā japen mantraṃ yāval-lakṣa-catuṣṭayam
atha mantra-mayyāṃ sad-ācāra-vidhir likhyate
mantra-mayī dvidhā
tatra śrī-
kṛṣṇa-deva-madhya-deśa-rājitaṃ virājitam
sarvātma-snapanaṃ paraṃ vijayate śrī-kṛṣṇa-saṅkīrtanam
abhyajya nārāyaṇa-taila-lepaiḥ
kṛṣṇāya gopīnāthāya govindāya namo namaḥ
kintu svāmini kṛṣṇa eva sahasā tat tām avāpya svayaṃ
sā kṛṣṇa-netra-kutukocita-rūpa-veṣaṃ
sandhyāyāṃ kṛṣṇa-devasya sārātrika-mukhaṃ narāḥ
dhṛdayaṃ jñātvā punaḥ kathitavān - śrī-jagannātha-pārśva-vartinaṃ śrī-kṛṣṇa-
pravartate
tathā hi, phālguna-śukla-daśamītaḥ caitra-kṛṣṇa-pratipat-paryantaṃ
atha śrī-rāma-navamī-
gandharva-vidyādhara-caraṇādayo
jñātaṃ cāyatīdaṃ janma-dinaṃ kṛṣṇa-candrasya

ya eko bahudhā kṛṣṇaḥ sṛṣṭyādau bahudheyate
ayanaṃ tasya yad abhūt tasmān nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ
viṣṇuḥ sattvaguṇādhīśaḥ sthitau sthāpayituṃ jagat
jñātvā tato bhṛgukulodbhavadhīravīraṃ rāmaṃ sugaurarucirāṃ pariṇīya sītām
śrīlakṣmaṇas tadavaro vanam etya rāmaṃ sītāṃ niṣecya bahukaṣṭa āsīt
jāto bhaviṣyati yaśo vipulaṃ prakartuṃ śrīkṛṣṇa ity abhihito 'khilaśaktipūrṇaḥ
tam ahaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmi kṛṣṇaṃ brahmāṇḍanāyakam
utpattipralayau caiva vidyāvidye gatāgatī
gṛhā bhūr astraśastre ca durgādyāḥ śriya īritāḥ
kiṃ vā vaikuṇṭhalokeśaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ
ataḥ sarvam etenāpi śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ
ataḥ sarvāvatārāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ kṛṣṇa ucyate
jñātvāpi sarvagaṃ viṣṇuṃ tāratamyena prītimān
gogopavanitāmunivṛndajuṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ purāṇapuruṣaṃ manasā smarāmi
oṃ namo vāsudevāya kṛṣṇāya paramātmane
oṃ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śrīpatiḥ śrīmān śrīdharaḥ śrīsukhāśrayaḥ
vidyāpatir vittapatiḥ satpatiḥ kamalāpatiḥ
āyurvedakaro vaidyarājo vidyāpradāyakaḥ
kālīyadarpadalano nāganārīnutipriyaḥ
śritasāṃdīpanigurur vidyāsāgarapāragaḥ
viṣṇuḥ sarvajagatpātā śāntaḥ śuddhaḥ sanātanaḥ
taraty addhā prapadye taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ gopālarūpiṇam
śaraṇaṃ me jagannāthaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ
ekam eva yajet kṛṣṇaṃ sarvadevamayaṃ dhiyā
gṛhāśramī viṣṇubhaktaḥ kuryāt kṛṣṇaṃ dhiyā smaran
kalatraputramitrādīn hitvā kṛṣṇaṃ samāśritāḥ

vikhanā nāma kaścid ṛṣiḥ, uta nārāyaṇaḥ? nārāyaṇa eva kevalaṃ.
"yadi vidyāc caturvedān sāṅgopaniṣadān dvijaḥ
"namas te devadeveśa" ity ārabhya stotramadhye "phenapācārya vālakhilya vikhano vikhanasa vaikhānasācārya abhagnayoga abhagnaparisaṅkhyāna" iti.
! ! MBh 12.325.4A: namas te devadeva.
sametyānyonyasaṃyogaṃ parasparasamāśrayāḥ
prākṛtaṃ brahmarūpasya viṣṇoḥ sthānam anuttamam
mahopaniṣadi: "athāto mahopaniṣadaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ. eko ha vai nārāyaṇa āsīd" ity ārabhya "tasya dhyānāntassthasya yajñastomam ucyate. tasmin caturdaśapuruṣā jāyante. ekā kanyā . daśendriyāṇi mana ekādaśaṃ tejo dvādaśam ahaṅkāraḥ trayodaśaḥ praṇāś caturdaśaḥ ātmā pañcadaśaḥ buddhir bhūtāni pañca tanmātrāṇi pañca mahābhūtāni ca sa ekaḥ pañcaviṃśaḥ puruṣaḥ." "atha punar eva nārāyaṇas so 'nyatkāmo manasā dhyāyata tasya dhyānāntassthasya lalāṭāt svedo 'patat, ta imāḥ pratatā āpaḥ, tāsu tejaḥ, tat tejo hiraṇmayam aṇḍam tatra brahmā caturmukho 'jāyata." iti.
pṛṣṭhato 'nuyayau viṣṇuṃ vastreṇocchādya cānanam
! ! DHN 81 om. ca smaryate.
"om ity ekākṣaraṃ brahma vyāharan saṃsmaran harim
! ! DHN 92 om. caturmukhaḥ.
āyāsāyāparaṃ karma vidyānyā śilpanaipuṇam
taṃ prāha bhagavān viṣṇuḥ praṇataṃ purataḥ sthitam
! ! DHN 91 om. viṣṇor.
! ! KrA: vikhanā iti vai viṣṇuḥ tajjā vaikhānasāḥ smṛtāḥ.
! ! DHN 100 om. vaikhānasānām.
vasiṣṭha: "api cedaṃ purā rāma śrutaṃ me brahmadarśanam
aiśvarye vāruṇe rāma rudrasyeśasya vai prabhoḥ
tathā vedās sopaniṣado vidyās sāvitry athāpi ca
! ! MBh: tathā vedāś ca sopaniṣado vidyā; DHN 113: tathā vedāś ca sopaniṣado vidyās.
! ! DHN 115: mantra taś.

atra śuddha-jīvasyāpi cid-

jīva-māyety ucyate

namasā tasyāpyayāya rudro'bhūt ity anena

gacchatīti prasiddheḥ

bṛhat-sahasra-nāmni ca

pratibimbavad vyavadhānenety arthaḥ
ato vidyāvidye mama tanū [BhP
rudraḥ krodha-samudbhavaḥ
nārāyaṇaḥ paraṃ brahma
tattvaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ param
puruṣaṃ kṛṣṇa-piṅgalam
eko ha nārāyaṇa āsīn na brahmā na ca śaṅkaraḥ
tathā viṣṇu-sāmānya-darśino doṣaḥ śrūyate
yathā vaiṣṇava-tantre
aikā yaṃ manasaś cāpi viṣṇu-sāmānya-darśinaḥ
yas tu nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ brahma-rudrādi-daivataiḥ
tathā ca mantra-varṇaḥ
madhye vāmanam āsīnaṃ viśve devā upāsata
umāṃ prati śrī-śivena śrī-viṣṇu-vākyam anukṛtam
tvaṃ ca rudra mahābāho moha-śāstrāṇi kāraya
param iti śrī-viṣṇu-pratipādaka-purāṇasyaiva samyag-jñāna-pradatvam
yathāgamaṃ yathā jñānaṃ niṣṭhā nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ

āsurās tu
nindati na cainam iti
tad uktaṃ viṣṇu-dharmāgnipurāṇayoḥ
viṣṇu-bhakti-paro daiva āsuras tad-viparyayaḥ
vedāṃś ca durgān dṛṣṭvā nirvidya sarva-vedārtha-sārasya śuddhākhaṇḍa-

iti viṣṇu-purāṇe

atītatvāt

ānvīkṣikīm ātma-vidyām
śrī-viṣṇor evāvatāro'yam
saṃjñā satyavratasya
pratimanvantarāvasāne'pi pralayaḥ śrūyate
śrī-viṣṇu-
puruṣa eva
skānde śrī-rāma-gītāyāṃ viśva-rūpaṃ darśayatas tasya brahma-
viṣṇu-rudra-kṛta-stuteḥ śravaṇāt
rāma-kṛṣṇāv iti bhuvo bhagavān aharad bharam
śrī-kṛṣṇa-rūpeṇa nijāṃśa-rūpatvād rāma-rūpeṇāpi bhārahāritvaṃ bhagavata
janitā viṣṇu-yaśaso nāmnā kalkir jagat-patiḥ
vidyācita eva iti śrutir manaś cid-ādīnām agnīnāṃ prakaraṇa-prāptaṃ
kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ samabhavat paramaḥ pumān yo
avatārāś ca prākṛta-vaibhave'vataraṇam iti
śrī-kṛṣṇa-sāhacaryeṇa śrī-
jyotiṣṭomādhikaraṇe vasante vasante ca jyotiṣā yajeta ity atra jyotiḥ-śabdo
kalābhyāṃ nitarāṃ hareḥ iti hareḥ kalā pṛthvī, ābhyāṃ rāma-
vaṃśayor avatīrṇāv ity arthaḥ
arjune tu narāveśaḥ kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇaḥ svayam
ity ādinā darśitaḥ
sa punaḥ kṛṣṇa ity arthāntarāpekṣayā mantavyam
yayor
eva samaṃ vīparyam ity ādi nyāyāt
tathā viṣṇu-dharme
taṃ prati śrī-bhagavad-vākyāc cārjunasyāpi śrī-kṛṣṇa-sakhatvena nārāyaṇa-
tat-pratītāv evāṃśa ivāṃśa iti jñeyam
nārāyaṇa-samo guṇaiḥ
ity atrāpi nārāyaṇaḥ paravyomādhipa eva guṇaiḥ samo yasyety eva
mahākāla-purādhipa eva śrī-kṛṣṇaṃ sākṣād evopadiṣṭavān iti vācyam
śrī-
dṛśyete
tat-tātparyottho yathāsau śrī-kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ bhagavān api yathā
divya-mūrtiṃ pradarśayan taiḥ samam ātmanaivātmānaṃ namaścakre
tad-rūpam ātmānaṃ namaścakre
tad-rūpeṇaiva sārjunam ātmānaṃ tathā
babhāṣe ca
tad uktaṃ - tasmai namo vraja-janaiḥ saha-cakre'tmanātmanai
bhāvaḥ
tathā ca harivaṃśe śrī-kṛṣṇa-vākyam
śrī-kṛṣṇa eveti darśayitum ākhyānāntaram āha ekadā iti
dṛśyante
tatra śrī-viṣṇu-purāṇe ujjahārātmanaḥ keśau sita-kṛṣṇau mahā-
keśo yo'sau varṇataḥ kṛṣṇa uktaḥ
] ity ādi-padye
sita-kṛṣṇa-keśa ity atra sita-kṛṣṇa-keśatvaṃ śobhaiva na

muktāphala-ṭīkāyāṃ keśau sukha-svāminau sito rāmaḥ ātmanaḥ sakāśād

gāyatrīnirvāṇaṃ
rudraśāntiḥ
oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya
śriyaṃ sarasvatīṃ gaurīṃ gaṇeśaṃ skandamīśvaram
sārātsāro hi bhagavān viṣṇuḥ sargādikṛdvibhuḥ
lakṣmīmiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
kālāgnirūpiṇam viṣṇuṃ jyotirbrahma parātparam /AP 1.011ab/
vidyāsāraṃ yadviditvā sarvajño jāyate naraḥ
viṣṇuḥ kālāgnirudro 'haṃ vidyāsāraṃ vadāmi te
vidyāsāraṃ purāṇaṃ yat sarvaṃ sarvasya kāraṇaṃ
dve vidye bhagavān viṣṇuḥ parā caivāparā ca ha /AP 1.015ab/
matsyādirūpiṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ brūhi sargādikāraṇam
ko bhavān nanu vai viṣṇur nārāyaṇa namostute /AP 2.010ab/
kūrmarūpaṃ samāsthāya dadhre viṣṇuś ca mandaram
gāvaścāpsaraso divyā lakṣmīrdevī hariṅgatā /AP 3.010ab/
gṛhītvā jagmurjanmādyā viṣṇuḥ strīrūpadhṛk tataḥ
śivamāha harī rudra jitā māyā tvayā hi me
rāme vanaṃ gate vairād atha rāmaḥ samāgataḥ /AP 4.018ab/
rāmaṃ sampreṣayāmāsa lakṣmaṇaṃ muninā saha
bharate 'tha gate rāmaḥ pitrādīnabhyapūjayat /AP 6.001ab/
tena vaireṇa sā rāma- vanavāsañca kāṅkṣati
kaikeyyā vañcito rāma rājyaṃ kuru nigṛhya mām
namaskṛtya bharadvājaṃ rāmaṃ lakṣmaṇamāgataḥ
pitā svargaṃ gato rāma ayodhyāyāṃ nṛpo bhava
rāmaḥ śrutvā jalaṃ datvā gṛhītvā pāduke vraja
rāmaṃ surūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā sā kāminī vākyamabravīt
rāmaṃ rāmo 'pi yuyudhe śarair vivyādha rākṣasān /AP 7.009ab/
sītayā prerito rāmaḥ śareṇāthāvadhīcca taṃ /AP 7.016ab/
rāmaḥ pampāsaro gatvā śocan sa śarvarīṃ tataḥ
sītāṃ tvaṃ prāśyase yadvat tathā rāma karomi te
ityuktvā sa gato rāmaṃ natvovāca harīśvaraḥ /AP 8.008ab/
jagmū rāmaṃ sasugrīvam apaśyantas tu jānakīm
jñātvā rāmaṃ sasugrīvaṃ vānarāḥ kathayantu vai
rāmaḥ sugrīvamitras tvāṃ mārgayan preṣayacca mām
rāmaḥ kathaṃ na nayati śṛṅkitāmabravīt kapiḥ
rāmaḥ sīte na jānīte jñātvā tvāṃ sa nayiṣyati
rāmaś ca iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
jitvā dadhimukhādīṃś ca dṛṣṭvā rāmañca te 'bruvan
hatvā tvaṃ rāvaṇaṃ sītāṃ prāpsyase rāma mā śuca
samudratīraṃ gatavān tatra rāmaṃ vibhīṣaṇaḥ
bhedayāmāsa rāmañca uvācābdhiḥ samāgataḥ /AP 9.030ab/
rāmaḥ śarair jarjaritaṃ rāvaṇañcākarodraṇe /AP 10.010ab/
ato gacchāmi yuddhāya rāmaṃ hanmi savānaram
indrokto mātalī rāmaṃ rathasthaṃ pracakāra tam
rāmaḥ śastraistamastraiś ca vavardha jalado yathā /AP 10.024ab/
kṛṣṇaścolūkhale baddho dāmnā vyagrayaśodayā
vṛndāvanagataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kāliyaṃ yamunāhradāt
māyāvatyā yayau kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇo hṛṣṭo 'tha rukmiṇī
śrutvā tu nāradāt kṛṣṇaḥ pradyumnabalabhadravān
śivādyaiḥ pūjito viṣṇuḥ soniruddha uṣādiyuk
uttarāyaṇamīkṣaṃś ca dhyāyan viṣṇuṃ stavan sthitaḥ
pāṇḍavāḥ sātyakiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sapta muktā na cāpare
prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ viṣṇuḥ praviśyākṣobhayattataḥ
ayanantasya tāḥ pūrvantena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ
sanatkumāraṃ rudrañca sasarja krodhasambhavam
prācīnavarhiṣaṃ śukraṃ gayaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vrajājinau
āsan viṣṇuś ca śakraś ca tvaṣṭā dhātā tathāryamā
pāvakaḥ pavamānobhūcchuciḥ svāhāgnijobhavat /AP 20.016ab/
samastaparivārāya acyutāya namo yajet
